items.title: 投資雷達》美國期中選舉倒數，該減碼觀望還是布局卡位?
paras: 聯準會鷹派升息、10年期公債殖利率逼近5%，市場的緊張情緒才剛稍微緩解，2026年期中選舉的腳步聲又近了。眾議院席次差距小、翻盤機率高，加上美伊戰事持續牽動油價與通膨走勢，選前的市場氛圍難免瀰漫著一股觀望氣氛，不少投資人也開始猶豫，是該先落袋為安、靜待選後塵埃落定，還是趁早卡位、把握選前這段行情。
1.油價與通膨抬高眾議院翻轉風險
2026年美國不改選總統，選舉焦點將集中在共和黨能否守住眾議院與參議院。由於眾議院席次差距通常較小，少數席次的移動就可能造成多數黨翻轉，因此相較於參議院，眾議院往往是期中選舉最具不確定性的戰場。

而在牽動選情的變數中，油價是相當關鍵的經濟指標。汽油價格直接反映在民眾日常支出，也會透過運輸與生產成本推升整體物價。從1978年至2022年的歷史資料來看，油價上漲期間，總統所屬政黨在眾議院平均流失31.4席，明顯高於油價下跌期間的6.4席，顯示選民對切身痛感的反應，往往比政策論述更直接地反映在投票行為上。這樣的歷史經驗放回2026年格外值得留意，若美伊戰事延長、油價與燃料價格維持高檔，通膨與生活成本壓力升高，汽油價格將成為選民對戰事最直接的感受，進而轉化為對執政共和黨經濟治理能力的評價，使民主黨爭取更多眾議院席次的機會增加。
2. 分裂國會未必是壞事

要判斷2026年選後是否形成分裂國會，關鍵在於民主黨能否拿下眾議院或參議院其中一院。若民主黨同時拿下兩院，則形成更嚴格意義上的分裂政府。市場經常將分裂政府或國會僵局直接解讀為政策效率下降，進而視為股市利空，但歷史資料並不支持這樣的推論。統計顯示，白宮、眾議院與參議院由同一政黨掌握與廣義分裂政府在期中選舉後一年美股平均均達近17%，即使是嚴格分裂國會，平均報酬仍達12.1%。換言之，國會版圖影響的主要是政策推動的速度與範圍，而非直接決定股市漲跌，即使國會分裂，企業獲利、經濟成長與利率環境仍可能持續支撐美股表現。
這個現象背後的邏輯並不難理解。分裂國會或跛腳政府意味著任何一方都難以單獨推動重大稅制改革、大規模財政支出或劇烈的產業與監管政策轉向，因為對手陣營有足夠的席次予以阻擋。這種立法僵局雖然聽起來像是政治效率的降低，但對投資人而言，卻代表政策的可預測性與穩定性提高，企業亦不必擔心稅率、關稅或監管規則在短時間內被大幅翻轉，可以更安心地規劃長期資本支出與營運策略。
3. 市場提前定價，選前布局歷史表現較佳
無論選後是否形成分裂國會，對股市而言，政治情勢真正發揮影響力的時間點其實遠早於投票日當天。市場往往在開票前就已經透過民調、候選人政見與預期席次變化，提前反映在股價與債券殖利率之中，因此真正重要的不是選舉結果本身，而是最終結果是否符合市場原先的預期。

從歷史資料觀察，在選前一個月買進標普500，持有1年後的平均報酬達19%，且無論持有3個月、6個月或1年，表現都明顯優於選舉當日才進場，反映市場會隨著選情發展提前調整資產價格，而非被動等待結果揭曉。這背後其實有一個容易被忽略的心理機制。當不確定性尚未解除時，投資人往往傾向要求更高的報酬來補償未知風險，使資產價格在選前存在一定的折價。隨著選情逐漸明朗，這份折價便會逐步收斂，資產價格也隨之修復回升。若結果符合預期，市場焦點將迅速轉向政策執行與經濟基本面，資金也會重新聚焦於企業獲利能見度與產業趨勢。因此，期中選舉較像是市場預期的一個轉折點，而不是單獨決定美股方向的關鍵變數。政治不確定性消退後，市場仍會回歸油價、通膨、利率、經濟成長與企業獲利等基本面。
鉅亨投資策略
從歷史經驗來看，期中選舉較像是市場預期的一個轉折點，而不是單獨決定美股方向的關鍵因素。無論選後是共和黨守住國會、還是民主黨拿下其中一院形成分裂國會，企業獲利、經濟成長與利率環境，仍是支撐美股表現的核心力量。對看好AI長期趨勢的投資人，可透過定期定額或分批布局；也可搭配鉅亨買基金「超底王」策略，在市場拉回時分批加碼，降低單一時點進場的影響。

items.title: 普丁：俄羅斯與一些國家不同 不會滿世界「乞討」
items.title_en: Putin: Russia, unlike some countries, will not beg around the world
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁30日（周四）在國家杜馬（議會下院）會議上發表講話，據《塔斯社》報導，普丁在講話中說，與一些國家不同，俄羅斯不會滿世界「乞討」。
普丁說：「與一些國家不同——就不點名了，俄羅斯不會跑到世界各地卑躬屈膝乞求施捨。首先，正如我剛才所說，這樣做非常恥辱。其次，沒有人會給我國，我國很清楚這一點。最後，也是最重要的一點，我國不需要這樣做。」
普丁強調，任何人都無法摧毀或恐嚇俄羅斯人民，俄羅斯有能力在未來幾代人中繼續確保國家安全和主權。
俄羅斯已於本月舉行國家杜馬選舉，這是2022年俄烏衝突全面升級以來首次國家杜馬選舉。統一俄羅斯黨贏得349席，俄羅斯聯邦共產黨獲37席，自由民主黨23席，新人黨19席，公正俄羅斯黨17席，祖國黨1席，4名自薦候選人各獲1席。
在當地時間30日召開的俄羅斯第九屆國家杜馬第一次全體會議上，統一俄羅斯黨推舉的國家杜馬主席候選人沃洛金再次當選國家杜馬主席。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke at a State Duma (lower house) meeting on Thursday, the 30th, and, according to TASS, said that unlike some countries, Russia will not go around the world “begging.”

Putin said: “Unlike some countries – I won’t name them – Russia will not crawl around the world, groveling and begging for charity. First, as I just mentioned, that would be deeply humiliating. Second, no one is going to give to our country, and we are well aware of that. Finally, and most importantly, our country does not need to do that.”
Putin emphasized that no one can destroy or intimidate the Russian people, and that Russia has the capability to continue ensuring national security and sovereignty for generations to come.

Russia held a State Duma election earlier this month, the first since the full‑scale escalation of the Russia‑Ukraine conflict in 2022. United Russia won 349 seats, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation secured 37 seats, the Liberal Democratic Party took 23 seats, New People obtained 19 seats, A Just Russia got 17 seats, the Patriots of Russia won 1 seat, and four self‑nominated candidates each received one seat.
At the first plenary session of the 9th State Duma held on the 30th local time, Volodin, the United Russia‑nominated candidate, was re‑elected as Chairman of the State Duma.

items.title: 川普10萬美元H-1B費用連遭兩法官阻擋 科技業招才再陷法律戰
items.title_en: Trump's $100,000 H‑1B Fee Blocked by Two Judges, Tech Hiring Faces New Legal Battles
paras: 美國總統川普針對新H-1B工作簽證加徵10萬美元費用的政策再遭法院阻擋。加州奧克蘭聯邦地區法院法官Haywood Gilliam週三(30日)裁定, 美國公民及移民服務局(USCIS)與國務院在執行這項費用前未遵循必要的規則制定程序, 因此禁止相關政府機構繼續執行這項收費措施。這也是第二名聯邦法官出手阻擋10萬美元H-1B費用。
Gilliam受理的是工會、企業及非營利組織組成的聯盟所提訴訟。該聯盟去年10月提告, 要求阻止川普政府實施這項費用。法院此次裁定暫停相關機構執行川普的10萬美元收費要求, 直至訴訟程序進一步發展。
這項判決與6月波士頓聯邦法院的裁決形成呼應。波士頓聯邦法官當時在20州提起的另一宗案件中, 認定川普政府設定10萬美元H-1B費用的做法違法並阻止政府收取; 第一巡迴上訴法院7月也拒絕暫停該判決, 代表政府在上訴期間無法恢復這項費用。
目前美國商會也另外提起訴訟挑戰10萬美元費用。該組織是美國規模最大的商業遊說團體, 此案則涉及另一名法官此前駁回商會主張後的上訴程序。換言之, 川普政府目前面對至少3條與10萬美元H-1B費用相關的法律戰線。
川普政府最初是在2025年9月宣布10萬美元費用, 對象主要是新的H-1B簽證申請, 並透過總統公告限制部分目前人在美國境外的申請人入境。政府主張, 總統依據聯邦移民法具有限制特定外國人入境的權力, 因此可以要求支付這項費用。川普及政府官員則表示, H-1B制度遭到部分企業濫用, 包括以較低薪資的外籍勞工取代美國勞工。
H-1B制度是美國企業聘用具專業技能外籍人才的重要管道, 每年一般配額為6.5萬個名額, 另有2萬個名額提供擁有美國高等學位的申請人, 簽證通常可核准3年並延長至6年。川普政府此次政策大幅提高企業成本, 在此之前H-1B相關費用通常約為2000至5000美元, 實際金額視申請類型等因素而定。
科技產業是H-1B制度的主要使用者之一。包括Amazon (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、Microsoft (MSFT-US)、Apple (AAPL-US)及Meta Platforms (META-US)等大型科技企業, 長期透過H-1B制度招聘工程、軟體、人工智慧及其他專業人才。近期科技產業團體也進一步反對政府提出的新一輪H-1B費用調升方案。
值得注意的是, 川普政府8月提出另一項金額為10萬3265美元的H-1B費用規則, 試圖透過正式行政規則制定程序, 將新的高額費用制度化。這項方案與目前遭法院阻擋的10萬美元總統公告費用屬於不同法律程序, 因此即使法院阻止原有10萬美元費用, 10萬3265美元的新規仍可能繼續推進, 但同樣可能面臨新的法律挑戰。
美國國土安全部(DHS)8月公布的提案顯示, 新費用設定為10萬3265美元, 目標是透過正式規則制定程序建立新的H-1B收費制度。與最初的總統公告不同, 這項方案經過公告及徵詢意見等行政程序, 因此政府希望以不同法律途徑建立長期制度。相關規則若最終定案, 仍可能遭企業及產業團體提告。
科技產業對10萬3265美元方案的反對也在近期升高。代表大型科技及人工智慧企業的TechNet在9月提交正式意見, 要求政府撤回這項費用。該組織表示, 高額費用可能限制美國企業取得全球專業人才的能力, 並可能影響美國在人工智慧領域的競爭力。TechNet成員包括多家大型網路及AI企業, 也包括輝達(NVDA-US)。
除了科技巨頭之外, 產業團體也指出, 高額固定費用對不同類型雇主的影響並不相同。H-1B大量使用者包括科技企業、顧問公司、外包服務商及研究機構, 而企業聘用外籍專業人才的成本將取決於實際申請數量及職缺需求。Reuters此前報導, H-1B計畫2025年雇主登記約34.4萬件, 比2024年下降逾25%, 也不到2023年75.9萬件的一半。
另一方面, H-1B政策變化已開始影響企業人才布局。Reuters此前報導, Google等主要H-1B使用企業在簽證審查與處理方式改變後, 已增加在印度等海外地區的業務布局。科技企業則表示, H-1B制度能協助企業招聘美國國內難以找到的專業人才。
H-1B申請量也受到政策變化影響。美國移民局資料顯示, 雇主在前一年度登記約34.4萬件H-1B申請, 較2024年的數字下降超過四分之一; 2023年申請量則曾達75.9萬件。至於最初10萬美元費用的實際支付情況, 法院文件顯示截至2026年2月底, 約70家雇主合計僅支付85件相關簽證申請的10萬美元費用。
川普政府同時持續推動H-1B制度其他改革, 包括加強申請人審查, 並提出新的簽證選擇方式, 讓較高技能及較高薪資的申請人獲得較有利的排序。政府也曾提出進一步調整制度的方案, 使H-1B政策不只涉及費用, 還涵蓋申請審查及名額分配方式。
對企業而言, 當前最大的問題在於10萬美元費用的法律地位仍未完全確定。雖然兩名聯邦法官已先後阻止政府執行原有費用, 且上訴法院此前拒絕讓政府在上訴期間恢復收費, 但美國商會的案件以及政府相關上訴仍在進行中。與此同時, 政府提出的10萬3265美元新規則又開啟另一條法律與行政程序, 因此H-1B費用問題短期內仍可能持續成為美國科技業及企業招聘政策的重要爭議。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump’s policy of imposing a $100,000 fee on new H‑1B work visas was again halted by the courts. On Wednesday (the 30th), U.S. District Judge Haywood Gilliam in the Oakland, California federal court ruled that the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) and the State Department failed to follow required rulemaking procedures before implementing the fee, and therefore barred the agencies from enforcing the charge. This marks the second federal judge to block the $100,000 H‑1B fee.

Judge Gilliam was hearing a lawsuit brought by a coalition of labor unions, businesses and nonprofit groups. The coalition filed the suit in October last year seeking to stop the Trump administration’s fee. The court’s order pauses the agencies’ enforcement of the $100,000 charge until the litigation progresses further.

The decision echoes a June ruling by a federal court in Boston. At that time a Boston judge, hearing a separate case filed in 20 states, found the administration’s $100,000 H‑1B fee unlawful and stopped the government from collecting it; the First Circuit Court of Appeals in July also refused to stay that ruling, meaning the fee could not be reinstated during the appeal.

The U.S. Chamber of Commerce has also filed a separate lawsuit challenging the $100,000 fee. The Chamber, the nation’s largest business‑lobbying group, is pursuing a case that involves a different judge who had previously dismissed the Chamber’s claim and is now hearing the appeal. In short, the Trump administration is confronting at least three separate legal fronts over the $100,000 H‑1B fee.

The Trump administration first announced the $100,000 fee in September 2025, targeting new H‑1B applications and, via a presidential proclamation, restricting entry for some applicants currently abroad. The administration argued that the president has authority under federal immigration law to limit entry of certain foreign nationals and therefore can require the fee. Trump and his officials said the H‑1B program is being abused by some firms that replace U.S. workers with lower‑paid foreign labor.

The H‑1B program is a key channel for U.S. companies to hire foreign professionals with specialized skills. The annual cap is generally 65,000 visas, plus an additional 20,000 for applicants with U.S. advanced degrees. Visas are typically approved for three years and can be extended to six. The Trump‑era policy would dramatically raise employer costs; previously H‑1B‑related fees ranged from about $2,000 to $5,000, depending on the type of petition.

The tech sector is one of the biggest users of the H‑1B program. Large technology firms such as Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Meta Platforms (META‑US) have long relied on H‑1B visas to recruit engineers, software developers, AI specialists and other professionals. Recent industry groups have also stepped up opposition to the administration’s new fee‑increase proposal.

It is noteworthy that in August the Trump administration proposed a separate $100,326.5 fee rule, attempting to codify the higher charge through the formal rulemaking process. This proposal follows a different legal pathway from the $100,000 fee announced by presidential proclamation, so even if courts block the original fee, the $100,326.5 rule could still move forward, though it may face fresh legal challenges.

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) released a proposal in August setting the new fee at $100,326.5, aiming to establish a permanent H‑1B fee structure via the formal rulemaking process. Unlike the initial proclamation, this proposal has gone through notice‑and‑comment procedures, and the administration hopes to create a lasting regime through a different legal route. If finalized, the rule could still be sued by companies and industry groups.

Opposition from the tech sector to the $100,326.5 proposal has intensified recently. TechNet, which represents large tech and AI firms, submitted formal comments in September urging the administration to withdraw the fee. The group warned that the steep charge could limit U.S. companies’ ability to attract global talent and hurt America’s competitiveness in artificial intelligence. TechNet’s members include several major internet and AI companies, as well as Nvidia (NVDA‑US).

Beyond the big tech players, industry groups note that a flat high fee does not affect all employers equally. Heavy H‑1B users include tech firms, consulting firms, outsourcing providers and research institutions, and the cost to hire foreign specialists will depend on the number of petitions and job‑level needs. Reuters previously reported that employer registrations for H‑1B in 2025 are projected at about 344,000, down more than 25% from 2024 and less than half of the 759,000 filings in 2023.

Changes to the H‑1B policy are already influencing corporate talent strategies. Reuters earlier reported that major H‑1B‑using companies such as Google have shifted visa review and processing practices and have expanded operations in overseas locations like India. Tech firms say the H‑1B program remains essential for hiring specialized talent that is scarce in the U.S. labor market.

Application volumes have also been affected by the policy shifts. USCIS data show that employers filed roughly 344,000 H‑1B petitions in the most recent fiscal year, a drop of more than a quarter from 2024’s figure; the 2023 filing count peaked at 759,000. Regarding actual payments of the original $100,000 fee, court filings indicate that by the end of February 2026 about 70 employers had paid the fee for only 85 visa petitions.

The Trump administration continues to push other H‑1B reforms, including tighter applicant vetting and a new visa selection system that gives higher‑skill, higher‑salary candidates more favorable ranking. The administration has also floated broader adjustments to the program, so that reforms go beyond fees to cover adjudication standards and allocation of the annual cap.

For companies, the biggest uncertainty remains the legal status of the $100,000 fee. Although two federal judges have already blocked the government’s ability to collect the original charge and the appellate court previously refused to let the fee be reinstated during the appeal, the Chamber of Commerce case and other government appeals are still pending. At the same time, the administration’s $100,326.5 rule opens a separate legal and administrative track, meaning the H‑1B fee issue is likely to stay a hot‑button dispute for the tech industry and corporate hiring policies in the near term.

items.title: 永笙臍帶血細胞製劑申請台灣藥證 擴大臍帶血臨床應用
items.title_en: Yong Sheng's Umbilical Cord Blood Cell Product Applies for Taiwan Drug License, Expanding Clinical Use of Cord Blood
paras: 永笙(4178-TW)宣布，旗下臍帶血細胞製劑REGENECYTE正式向台灣TFDA申請台灣再生醫療製劑查驗登記，進一步擴大符合國際規格的臍帶血細胞製劑臨床應用。
永笙REGENECYTE已通過美國FDA生物製劑許可，核准應用於80種造血與免疫系統疾病。過去台灣臍帶血臨床應用的範圍為既有公告的29項疾病，而REGENECYTE經美國FDA BLA核准應用的範圍較台灣更為廣泛，期望能擴大台灣臍帶血臨床應用。不過實際核准用途及適應症範圍，仍以TFDA最終審查結果為準。
永笙指出，此次申請台灣藥證，將過去累積的資源及經驗導入台灣，為有移植需求的患者提供符合國際規範且品管更嚴謹的治療選項，並以此為基礎，持續拓展更多的適應症臨床應用。
副總經理張碩修表示，目前永笙擁有超過3.6萬單位的自有公捐臍帶血庫資源，已有超過2300劑成功應用於臨床移植，並獲全球350家醫學中心採用，具備AABB及FACT雙重國際品質認證。未來將在既有規模上，持續推動臨床研究與醫療機構合作，擴大自有細胞資源的商業價值與國際布局。
paras_en: Yong Sheng (4178-TW) announced that its umbilical cord blood cell product REGENECYTE has formally applied to Taiwan's TFDA for registration of a regenerative medical product, further expanding clinical use of cord blood cell products that meet international standards.

REGENECYTE has received US FDA biologics approval, authorized for 80 hematologic and immune system diseases. Previously, the scope of cord blood clinical use in Taiwan covered 29 diseases announced earlier, whereas REGENECYTE's FDA BLA‑approved indications are broader than Taiwan's, and the company hopes to expand clinical use in Taiwan. However, the actual approved uses and indication range will depend on the TFDA’s final review.

Yong Sheng said that this Taiwan drug application brings accumulated resources and experience to Taiwan, offering patients needing transplantation a treatment option that complies with international specifications and has stricter quality control, and will use this as a basis to continue expanding clinical applications for more indications.

Deputy General Manager Zhang Shuo‑xiu stated that Yong Sheng currently holds over 36,000 units of its own public‑donated cord blood bank, with more than 2,300 doses successfully used in clinical transplants, adopted by 350 medical centers worldwide, and holds dual AABB and FACT international quality certifications. Going forward, the company will continue to promote clinical research and collaborations with medical institutions, expanding the commercial value and international footprint of its own cell resources.

items.title: AI支出續強勁 美銀點名美光、輝達、英特爾等「贏家」
items.title_en: AI Spending Remains Strong, BofA Names Micron, Nvidia, Intel and Others as Winners
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，今年只剩下3個月，對華爾街而言，這意味著市場開始展望明年的經濟、股市與各產業表現。分析師提出的重要觀點帶動相關股票走勢並不罕見，尤其當這些看法同時伴隨目標價與獲利預估上調時，更容易對股價產生影響。
以下是近期第一批值得關注的前瞻性市場觀點之一，來自美國銀行半導體分析師Vivek Arya，聚焦於AI熱潮核心企業的動能型科技股。
Arya指出，AI資本支出有很大機會高於許多市場預期，並成為多檔股票超乎預期的順風力量。
談到AI基礎設施前景，Arya表示，「我們將2026年至2030年AI資料中心系統的整體潛在市場(TAM)預估，從原先的1.8兆美元、年增33%，上調至2.2兆美元，年增達40%。」
「消費者與企業採用AI代理工具形成的良性循環、公有與私有AI實驗室之間的競爭，以及晶片供應有限，都可能讓未來幾年的AI支出保持強勁。」
他表示，先進AI模型若放慢開發進度或增加安全防護措施，可能反而增加而非降低運算需求，並讓更多需求從訓練轉向成長速度更快的推理運算。
同時，頂尖晶片股的估值相較每股盈餘(EPS)成長預估仍具吸引力。費城半導體指數目前的預估本益比為21倍，比ChatGPT問世以來24倍的中位數本益比低12%，而EPS成長潛力預估則超過40%。

看好的晶片股贏家

在Arya修正後的AI投資論點下，多檔股票都具備看多條件。
Arya寫道，「從歷史來看，第四曆季(CQ4)與第一曆季(CQ1)是持有晶片股表現最好的兩個季。2010年至2025年期間，晶片股相較標普500指數的中位數超額報酬為300至500個基點。」
他指出目前最看好個股，以及近期催化因素包括：

輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)：加大股票回購，以及多場GTC科技大會活動。
英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)：AI代理帶動CPU需求，以及市場期待其晶圓代工業務取得新訂單。
美光(Micron)(MU-US)：預計12月9日起啟動股票回購。
邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)：10月6日舉行分析師日，以及XPU出貨量提升。
科林研發(Lam Research)(LRCX-US)：有望在記憶體與邏輯晶片領域提高市占率。


此外，美銀也持續看好AMD(AMD-US)、應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)、亞德諾半導體(Analog Devices)(ADI-US)與安森美(On Semiconductor)(ON-US)。
同時持續關注博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)。美銀目前給予該股買進評級，主要是看好博通具吸引力的估值。並指出，博通「12月公布第四財季業績時，也可能宣布加大股票回購。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that with only three months left in the year, Wall Street is beginning to look ahead to next year’s economy, stock market and sector performance. It is not uncommon for analysts’ key viewpoints to drive related stock moves, especially when those views are accompanied by target‑price and earnings‑forecast upgrades, which can more easily affect share prices.

One of the first forward‑looking market viewpoints to watch recently comes from Bank of America semiconductor analyst Vivek Arya, who focuses on momentum‑driven tech stocks at the core of the AI boom.
Arya said AI capital spending has a high chance of exceeding many market expectations and will become a tailwind that pushes several stocks beyond forecasts.

Discussing the outlook for AI infrastructure, Arya stated, “We have revised our estimate of the total addressable market (TAM) for AI data‑center systems from 2026 to 2030, raising it from the original $1.8 trillion with a 33% annual growth rate to $2.2 trillion with a 40% annual growth rate.”

He added that a virtuous cycle of consumer and enterprise adoption of AI agents, competition between public and private AI labs, and limited chip supply could keep AI spending robust for the coming years.

He noted that if the development of advanced AI models slows or more safety safeguards are added, compute demand could actually increase rather than decrease, shifting more demand from training to faster‑growing inference workloads.

At the same time, valuations for top chip stocks remain attractive relative to projected earnings‑per‑share (EPS) growth. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index currently trades at a forward P/E of 21×, about 12% below the post‑ChatGPT median of 24×, while EPS growth potential is estimated at over 40%.
Chip‑stock winners under Arya’s revised AI investment thesis have multiple stocks with bullish upside.

Arya wrote, “Historically, the fourth calendar quarter (CQ4) and the first calendar quarter (CQ1) have been the two best quarters for holding chip stocks. From 2010 to 2025, chip stocks have delivered median excess returns of 300 to 500 basis points over the S&P 500.”
He highlighted the individual stocks he is most bullish on, along with near‑term catalysts:

Nvidia (NVDA‑US): larger share‑repurchase program and multiple GTC technology‑conference events. Intel (INTC‑US): AI agents driving CPU demand and market expectations of new wafer‑fab orders. Micron (MU‑US): planned share‑repurchase program starting Dec 9. Marvell (MRVL‑US): analyst day on Oct 6 and rising XPU shipments. Lam Research (LRCX‑US): potential market‑share gains in memory and logic chips.

In addition, BofA continues to favor AMD (AMD‑US), Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Analog Devices (ADI‑US) and ON Semiconductor (ON‑US). It also remains watchful of Broadcom (AVGO‑US), which BofA rates as a buy due to its attractive valuation and notes that Broadcom may announce an expanded share‑repurchase program when it reports fourth‑quarter results in December.

items.title: 天安門廣場舉行升國旗儀式 現場1萬隻和平鴿放飛
items.title_en: Flag-Raising Ceremony Held at Tiananmen Square, Over 10,000 Peace Doves Released
paras: 今天（1日）是中國國慶，新中國迎來77周年華誕，天安門廣場舉行2026年國慶升旗儀式。
凌晨1點20分，天安門廣場已十分熱鬧，不少民眾早早趕來等候升旗儀式，大家席地而坐，有人帶上小馬扎、毛毯，還有人鋪開被子就地休息。
據《九派新聞》報導，吉林李女士是第一次觀看升旗儀式，帶著父親和妹妹坐了6個小時高鐵於30日抵達北京，10月1日凌晨1點來到天安門樓排隊，等候升旗。
來自上海今年72歲的王爺爺（化姓）表示，他和家人坐了5個多小時的車抵達北京，也是凌晨1點在此排隊等候。
一名從新疆來的遊客表示，他坐了兩天的車抵達北京，晚上6、7點就來到天安門廣場附近排隊。「現在心情很激動，」他說，父母一直想來首都看看，但由於雙親年紀太大，這次並未能來，他感到很遺憾。
升國旗儀式結束後，10,000多隻和平鴿在天安門放飛，現場民眾高唱《歌唱祖國》。
paras_en: Today (the 1st) is China’s National Day, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic, and a flag‑raising ceremony for the 2026 National Day was held at Tiananmen Square.

At 1:20 a.m., Tiananmen Square was already bustling; many people arrived early to wait for the ceremony, sitting on the ground, some bringing small folding stools or blankets, and others spreading out bedding to rest on site.

According to Jiupai News, Ms. Li from Jilin was watching the flag‑raising for the first time. She traveled with her father and sister, taking a six‑hour high‑speed train to Beijing on the 30th and arrived at Tiananmen Tower at 1 a.m. on October 1 to line up for the ceremony.
A 72‑year‑old man from Shanghai, referred to as Grandpa Wang (surname changed), said he and his family drove more than five hours to Beijing and also joined the queue at 1 a.m.

A tourist from Xinjiang said he spent two days traveling by car to reach Beijing and arrived near Tiananmen Square around 6 or 7 p.m. to line up. “I’m very emotional now,” he said. His parents have always wanted to see the capital, but because they are very old they could not come this time, which he regrets.
After the flag‑raising ceremony, more than 10,000 peace doves were released over Tiananmen, and the crowd sang “Sing of the Motherland” at the venue.

items.title: 台新00904、00947本季配息雙創新高 年化配息率衝20%
items.title_en: Taishin 00904 and 00947 Set New Quarterly Dividend Records, Annualized Yield Hits 20%
paras: 台股 ETF 十月除息秀登場，台新臺灣半導體30(00904)與台新臺灣IC設計(00947)兩檔季配半導體ETF公布最新配息，在 AI 浪潮助攻下，00904 預計每單位配息2.2元、00947擬配 2 元，配息金額同步創成立以來新高，若用 9/30 收盤價推算，預估年化配息率分別達 20.26%、19.77%。
進一步觀察兩檔ETF統計至9/30含息報酬率，00947近1年績效174.12%，勇奪台股主被動ETF績效第一名；00904同期報酬率達141.28%，挺進台股ETF績效第四名，均呈翻倍漲，10月預估配息金額更雙箭齊發，投資人如欲參與2檔ETF除息，根據台新投信官網公布，00904、00947訂於除息日10/16(五)、最後買進日10/15(四)、股息發放日11/6(五)。
ETF理財達人表示，00904今年首次拉高配息，從上季0.68元來到本季2.2元，讓喜愛半導體ETF的存股族超級驚喜；另外，00947今年績效表現突出，最新公告配息亦大幅提高每單位配息金額，從上季0.3元來到本季2元，同時讓追求資本利得的半導體ETF族驚豔。
兩檔ETF上季配息僅花2天填息完成，都創下填息天數最短紀錄，搭配本季配息金額吸睛，同時，00904截至9/30股價43.43元、00947股價40.46元，雙雙突破40元以上，月線與季線也剛完成黃金交叉向上，預估股價還有機會向上攻堅，看好台股在第四季旺季行情帶動下，半導體股波段行情有戲，提供00904、00947順勢拉高填息機率。
台新投信量化投資團隊表示，兩檔ETF雖然同樣聚焦台灣半導體產業，但投資定位各有特色。00904鎖定台灣半導體完整產業鏈，投資範圍涵蓋晶圓製造、IC設計、封裝測試、記憶體及半導體設備等領域；00947則進一步聚焦IC設計與高成長科技族群，掌握AI運算、ASIC、記憶體、邊緣運算及高速傳輸等科技趨勢，兩檔產品形成「全產業鏈+IC設計」的雙主軸布局。
台新投信強調，現階段台灣半導體供應鏈，直接掌握全球AI基建核心發展命脈，在2027年美股企業獲利持續成長與AI需求穩健擴張下，AI基建投資浪潮將直接回歸基本面，提供高技術門檻、高訂單能見度與高產業競爭優勢的台廠半導體鏈，直接進入全球AI超級週期的全盛時代。
建議投資人可以長線布局半導體ETF，鎖定IC設計+記憶體為主的臺灣IC設計ETF為主，另搭配臺灣半導體全產業型ETF，雙管齊下打造半導體資產的「強強組合」，以完整捕捉代理式AI興起下的新一輪牛市爆發潛力。

paras_en: Taiwan stock ETFs held their October ex‑dividend showcase, with Taishin Taiwan Semiconductor 30 (00904) and Taishin Taiwan IC Design (00947) announcing their latest quarterly payouts. Boosted by the AI wave, 00904 plans a dividend of NT$2.2 per unit and 00947 NT$2.0, both the highest since inception. Using the closing price on September 30, the estimated annualized yields are 20.26% and 19.77% respectively.

Looking further at the performance up to September 30, the total return including dividends for 00947 over the past year was 174.12%, ranking it first among Taiwan’s active and passive ETFs. 00904 posted a 141.28% return for the same period, placing fourth among Taiwan ETFs, both more than doubling in value. In October the projected payouts are set to surge, and investors who wish to participate can note the ex‑dividend date of October 16 (Friday), the last purchase day of October 15 (Thursday) and the dividend payment date of November 6 (Friday) as posted on Taishin Asset Management’s website.

ETF experts note that 00904 raised its dividend for the first time this year, jumping from NT$0.68 last quarter to NT$2.2 this quarter, delighting dividend‑focused semiconductor investors. Likewise, 00947 delivered a standout performance this year, increasing its dividend from NT$0.30 last quarter to NT$2.0 this quarter, impressing those seeking capital gains from semiconductor ETFs.

Both ETFs completed their previous quarter’s dividend payouts in just two days, setting a record for the shortest payout period, and the current quarter’s dividend amounts are eye‑catching. As of September 30, 00904 traded at NT$43.43 and 00947 at NT$40.46, both above NT$40. Their monthly and quarterly moving averages have just formed a bullish golden cross, suggesting further upside potential. With the fourth‑quarter seasonal rally expected to lift semiconductor stocks, the ETFs are well positioned for continued price gains.

Taishin’s quantitative investment team explains that although both ETFs focus on Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, their investment approaches differ. 00904 targets the full semiconductor value chain, covering wafer fabrication, IC design, packaging and testing, memory and equipment. 00947 narrows in on IC design and high‑growth tech groups, capturing trends such as AI computing, ASICs, memory, edge computing and high‑speed transmission, creating a dual‑pillar “full‑chain + IC design” strategy.

Taishin emphasizes that Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain now directly controls the core of global AI infrastructure development. With U.S. corporate earnings projected to keep rising through 2027 and robust AI demand, the AI‑infrastructure investment wave will revert to fundamentals, favoring Taiwanese firms with high technical barriers, visible order pipelines and strong competitive advantages, positioning them at the peak of a global AI super‑cycle.

Investors are advised to take a long‑term stance on semiconductor ETFs, focusing on Taiwan’s IC‑design‑and‑memory‑centric ETF while also adding the broader Taiwan semiconductor ETF. This two‑pronged “strong‑pair” approach aims to capture the full upside of the next AI‑driven bull market.

items.title: AI資料中心搶電！Bloom Energy今年暴漲219% 克雷默仍看好但喊「先別追」
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Scramble for Power! Bloom Energy Soars 219% This Year, Cramer Still Bullish but Says “Don’t Chase Yet”
paras: CNBC知名財經節目主持人克雷默(Jim Cramer)週三表示，在AI資料中心建設帶動的「表後供電」(behind-the-meter)市場中，Bloom Energy (BE-US)仍是他最看好的投資方式，但目前並不是他願意立即進場追價的時點。克雷默認為，若投資人希望掌握AI基礎建設背後快速增加的電力需求，Bloom Energy仍是他的首選標的之一，長期而言股價未來幾年仍可能進一步走高。
Bloom Energy今年股價已大漲219%，其中9月單月上漲34%，主要受到AI資料中心建設加速及現場燃料電池需求升溫帶動。該股自克雷默今年2月介紹這家公司以來，股價幾乎已翻倍。
Bloom Energy的核心技術是模組化固態氧化物燃料電池系統，可部署在資料中心等大型用電設施附近，直接提供主要或備援電力，不必完全依賴公共電網。系統可將燃料轉換為電力而不透過傳統燃燒方式發電，因此能以模組化方式擴充，成為AI資料中心在等待電網接入期間的替代供電方案。
AI資料中心目前面臨的核心限制之一就是電力。資料中心的規模通常以需要多少GW的持續電力來衡量，隨著AI運算需求增加，電力供應已成為決定資料中心能否擴建的重要因素。Bloom Energy的現場供電系統則主打縮短取得電力所需的時間，避免業者必須等待數年才能完成新的電網連接。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)就是其中一個案例。Bloom Energy表示，公司曾在55天內完成向甲骨文一座資料中心供電的部署，遠低於傳統大型電力基礎建設可能需要的時間。兩家公司今年4月也進一步擴大合作，甲骨文旗下AI及雲端基礎建設計畫將採購最多2.8GW的Bloom燃料電池系統，其中初始1.2GW容量已簽約並開始部署。
Bloom Energy的財務表現也反映AI資料中心需求的快速成長。公司第2季營收達約10.7億美元，年增166%，明顯超越市場預期；調整後每股盈餘為0.78美元，幾乎是市場原先預期的兩倍。公司並上調2026年全年營收預測至39億至42億美元，中間值約40.5億美元，意味著全年營收規模可望較前一年翻倍。
Bloom Energy在2025年全年營收已達20.2億美元，較2024年的14.7億美元增加37.3%，公司當時表示，AI資料中心產業的需求是推動營收創新高的重要因素。
Bloom Energy表示，包括大型超大規模雲端服務商、超過12家neocloud業者及AI實驗室在內的客戶，都已對其技術表示支持或完成驗證，顯示現場供電市場正從早期測試階段逐步進入商業部署。
Bloom Energy近期也持續強化AI電力布局。公司9月推出Power Connect技術，主打將現場電力安裝時間縮短超過40%；此外，公司持續推動800V DC-native電力架構，針對AI資料中心高密度運算所需的電力環境，降低傳統交流電轉換過程可能造成的損耗及設備需求。
Bloom Energy同時面臨來自其他表後發電技術的競爭，包括GE Vernova (GEV-US)的大型燃氣渦輪機。與Bloom Energy的模組化燃料電池不同，GE Vernova主要透過大型燃氣渦輪機提供電力，兩家公司都試圖搶攻AI資料中心快速增加的現場供電需求。
隨著AI資料中心建設規模不斷擴大，電力供應的重要性也從AI產業的周邊議題逐漸轉變為核心基礎建設。Bloom Energy今年大幅增加的營收、甲骨文的大型訂單，以及其他AI業者的採用，均使市場更加關注現場發電能否成為傳統電網之外的重要供電來源。
不過，克雷默也提醒投資人不要因看好AI電力需求就追高Bloom Energy。按照當時市場預期，Bloom Energy股價約相當於今年預估每股盈餘的108倍，以及明年預估每股盈餘的59倍，估值已反映相當高的成長預期。
因此，克雷默雖然仍將Bloom Energy視為AI電力需求的首選投資方式，但他的看法並非建議投資人立即買進，而是等待股價回檔後再評估長期布局機會。Bloom Energy預計10月27日公布第3季財報，屆時營收、訂單及AI資料中心相關業務進展，將成為市場觀察公司成長能否延續的重要指標。
paras_en: CNBC’s well‑known finance show host Jim Cramer said on Wednesday that in the behind‑the‑meter market driven by AI data‑center construction, Bloom Energy (BE‑US) remains his top investment pick, but it’s not a time he’s willing to jump in and buy at current prices. Cramer believes that investors looking to capture the rapidly growing electricity demand behind AI infrastructure should still consider Bloom Energy as one of his preferred targets, and the stock could keep climbing over the next few years.

Bloom Energy’s stock has already surged 219% this year, including a 34% jump in September, mainly fueled by accelerated AI data‑center builds and rising on‑site fuel‑cell demand. Since Cramer first highlighted the company in February, the share price has almost doubled.

Bloom Energy’s core technology is a modular solid‑oxide fuel‑cell system that can be deployed near large‑load facilities such as data centers, providing primary or backup power without relying entirely on the public grid. The system converts fuel to electricity without traditional combustion, allowing modular expansion and serving as an alternative power source while AI data centers wait for grid connections.

One of the key constraints facing AI data centers today is electricity. Data‑center size is often measured by the gigawatts of continuous power required, and as AI compute demand rises, power supply becomes a decisive factor for expansion. Bloom Energy’s on‑site power solution promises to shorten the time needed to secure electricity, avoiding years‑long waits for new grid hookups.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) is one example. Bloom Energy said it completed power deployment to an Oracle data center in just 55 days, far quicker than the timeline typical for large‑scale grid projects. In April the two companies expanded their partnership, with Oracle’s AI and cloud infrastructure program set to purchase up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel‑cell systems, of which an initial 1.2 GW has already been contracted and is being rolled out.

Bloom Energy’s financials also reflect the rapid growth of AI data‑center demand. Q2 revenue reached roughly $1.07 billion, up 166% year‑over‑year and well ahead of expectations; adjusted EPS was $0.78, nearly double market forecasts. The company lifted its 2026 full‑year revenue outlook to $3.9‑$4.2 billion, with a midpoint of about $4.05 billion, implying revenue could double from the prior year.

For the full year 2025, Bloom Energy reported $2.02 billion in revenue, a 37.3% increase from $1.47 billion in 2024, noting that demand from the AI data‑center sector was a key driver of the record‑high sales.

Bloom Energy said that customers—including large hyperscale cloud providers, more than 12 neocloud operators, and AI labs—have either endorsed or completed validation of its technology, indicating that the on‑site power market is moving from early testing toward commercial deployment.

Bloom Energy has also been strengthening its AI‑power footprint. In September the company launched Power Connect technology, claiming to cut on‑site installation time by over 40%; it is also advancing an 800 V DC‑native power architecture to reduce losses and equipment needs associated with traditional AC conversion for high‑density AI compute workloads.

Bloom Energy also faces competition from other behind‑the‑meter power technologies, such as GE Vernova’s (GEV‑US) large gas turbines. Unlike Bloom’s modular fuel cells, GE Vernova relies on big gas turbines, but both firms are vying for the fast‑growing on‑site power demand of AI data centers.

As AI data‑center construction scales up, power supply is shifting from a peripheral issue to a core infrastructure concern for the AI industry. Bloom Energy’s sharply higher revenue this year, Oracle’s sizable order, and adoption by other AI players are drawing market attention to whether on‑site generation can become a major power source beyond the traditional grid.

However, Cramer cautioned investors not to chase Bloom Energy simply because he is bullish on AI power demand. Based on current market expectations, the stock trades at roughly 108 times this year’s estimated EPS and 59 times next year’s estimate, reflecting a very high growth premium already priced in.

Thus, while Cramer still views Bloom Energy as his top pick for AI power demand, he does not recommend buying immediately. He suggests waiting for a price pull‑back before evaluating a long‑term position. Bloom Energy is slated to release its Q3 results on October 27, when revenue, orders and AI‑data‑center‑related progress will be key gauges of continued growth.

items.title: 永笙臍帶血細胞製劑申請台灣藥證 擴大臍帶血臨床應用
items.title_en: Yong Sheng's Umbilical Cord Blood Cell Product Applies for Taiwan Drug License, Expanding Clinical Use of Cord Blood
paras: 永笙(4178-TW)宣布，旗下臍帶血細胞製劑REGENECYTE正式向台灣TFDA申請台灣再生醫療製劑查驗登記，進一步擴大符合國際規格的臍帶血細胞製劑臨床應用。
永笙REGENECYTE已通過美國FDA生物製劑許可，核准應用於80種造血與免疫系統疾病。過去台灣臍帶血臨床應用的範圍為既有公告的29項疾病，而REGENECYTE經美國FDA BLA核准應用的範圍較台灣更為廣泛，期望能擴大台灣臍帶血臨床應用。不過實際核准用途及適應症範圍，仍以TFDA最終審查結果為準。
永笙指出，此次申請台灣藥證，將過去累積的資源及經驗導入台灣，為有移植需求的患者提供符合國際規範且品管更嚴謹的治療選項，並以此為基礎，持續拓展更多的適應症臨床應用。
副總經理張碩修表示，目前永笙擁有超過3.6萬單位的自有公捐臍帶血庫資源，已有超過2300劑成功應用於臨床移植，並獲全球350家醫學中心採用，具備AABB及FACT雙重國際品質認證。未來將在既有規模上，持續推動臨床研究與醫療機構合作，擴大自有細胞資源的商業價值與國際布局。
paras_en: Yong Sheng (4178-TW) announced that its umbilical cord blood cell product REGENECYTE has formally applied to Taiwan's TFDA for registration of a regenerative medical product, further expanding clinical use of cord blood cell products that meet international standards.

REGENECYTE has received US FDA biologics approval, authorized for 80 hematologic and immune system diseases. Previously, the scope of cord blood clinical use in Taiwan covered 29 diseases announced earlier, whereas REGENECYTE's FDA BLA‑approved indications are broader than Taiwan's, and the company hopes to expand clinical use in Taiwan. However, the actual approved uses and indication range will depend on the TFDA’s final review.

Yong Sheng said that this Taiwan drug application brings accumulated resources and experience to Taiwan, offering patients needing transplantation a treatment option that complies with international specifications and has stricter quality control, and will use this as a basis to continue expanding clinical applications for more indications.

Deputy General Manager Zhang Shuo‑xiu stated that Yong Sheng currently holds over 36,000 units of its own public‑donated cord blood bank, with more than 2,300 doses successfully used in clinical transplants, adopted by 350 medical centers worldwide, and holds dual AABB and FACT international quality certifications. Going forward, the company will continue to promote clinical research and collaborations with medical institutions, expanding the commercial value and international footprint of its own cell resources.

paras_en: Taiwan stock ETFs held their October ex‑dividend showcase, with Taishin Taiwan Semiconductor 30 (00904) and Taishin Taiwan IC Design (00947) announcing their latest quarterly payouts. Boosted by the AI wave, 00904 plans a dividend of NT$2.2 per unit and 00947 NT$2.0, both the highest since inception. Using the closing price on September 30, the estimated annualized yields are 20.26% and 19.77% respectively.

Looking further at the performance up to September 30, the total return including dividends for 00947 over the past year was 174.12%, ranking it first among Taiwan’s active and passive ETFs. 00904 posted a 141.28% return for the same period, placing fourth among Taiwan ETFs, both more than doubling in value. In October the projected payouts are set to surge, and investors who wish to participate can note the ex‑dividend date of October 16 (Friday), the last purchase day of October 15 (Thursday) and the dividend payment date of November 6 (Friday) as posted on Taishin Asset Management’s website.

ETF experts note that 00904 raised its dividend for the first time this year, jumping from NT$0.68 last quarter to NT$2.2 this quarter, delighting dividend‑focused semiconductor investors. Likewise, 00947 delivered a standout performance this year, increasing its dividend from NT$0.30 last quarter to NT$2.0 this quarter, impressing those seeking capital gains from semiconductor ETFs.

Both ETFs completed their previous quarter’s dividend payouts in just two days, setting a record for the shortest payout period, and the current quarter’s dividend amounts are eye‑catching. As of September 30, 00904 traded at NT$43.43 and 00947 at NT$40.46, both above NT$40. Their monthly and quarterly moving averages have just formed a bullish golden cross, suggesting further upside potential. With the fourth‑quarter seasonal rally expected to lift semiconductor stocks, the ETFs are well positioned for continued price gains.

Taishin’s quantitative investment team explains that although both ETFs focus on Taiwan’s semiconductor sector, their investment approaches differ. 00904 targets the full semiconductor value chain, covering wafer fabrication, IC design, packaging and testing, memory and equipment. 00947 narrows in on IC design and high‑growth tech groups, capturing trends such as AI computing, ASICs, memory, edge computing and high‑speed transmission, creating a dual‑pillar “full‑chain + IC design” strategy.

Taishin emphasizes that Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain now directly controls the core of global AI infrastructure development. With U.S. corporate earnings projected to keep rising through 2027 and robust AI demand, the AI‑infrastructure investment wave will revert to fundamentals, favoring Taiwanese firms with high technical barriers, visible order pipelines and strong competitive advantages, positioning them at the peak of a global AI super‑cycle.

Investors are advised to take a long‑term stance on semiconductor ETFs, focusing on Taiwan’s IC‑design‑and‑memory‑centric ETF while also adding the broader Taiwan semiconductor ETF. This two‑pronged “strong‑pair” approach aims to capture the full upside of the next AI‑driven bull market.

items.title: 智伸科(4551)下半年營運轉強 AI水冷、半導體雙引擎點火
items.title_en: SmartTech (4551) Sees Stronger H2 Operations as AI Water‑Cooling and Semiconductor Engines Ignite
paras: 2026年10月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 智伸科(4551-TW)下半年營運動能明顯轉強，7月營收月增10%、年增23.12%，8月營收達8.02億元、年增33.5%，已連續10個月維持正成長。隨AI伺服器水冷與半導體設備零件開始放量，公司成長主軸正從傳統車用逐步轉向科技事業。
智伸科2026年進入轉型收割期，上半年科技事業營收占比已升至16%，高於2025年的10.4%，7月單月半導體與其他事業占比更首度突破20%。相較之下，車用事業占比則一路下滑，公司長期目標是降至40%左右。
其中，AI伺服器水冷成為新一波成長焦點。智伸科自7月起開始出貨對應Vera Rubin平台的UQD產品（UQD的關鍵組件），越南廠也預計於第3季底加入量產，將進一步推升營運動能。隨Vera Rubin NVL72朝100%全液冷設計發展，加上單櫃功率密度與每托盤快接頭用量同步提升，UQD需求量可望明顯高於GB200、GB300世代。
法人預估，2026年半導體與散熱相關營收貢獻可望較2025年翻倍，2027年再成長近一倍，占比有機會升至30%。若Vera Rubin與客製化ASIC液冷平台同步放量，UQD有機會成為智伸科科技事業中成長最快的產品線之一。
半導體設備零件也同步擴大。智伸科已取得ASML認證，切入EUV與DUV曝光機相關自動化零件，並供應Brooks Instrument質量流量控制器(MFC)閥體與CMP零組件，科技事業的產品線正持續延伸。
獲利表現也開始反映產品組合改善。2026年第2季營收年增25%，毛利率升至24.58%，創2023年以來新高。不過，越南廠前置費用與半導體新品打樣仍造成短期干擾，第2季營業利益季減11%。
醫療事業則相對偏弱，2026年上半年受客戶遞延拉貨影響，營收占比降至8.7%，年減8.7%，全年成長預期也由原先40%下修至15%。遞延訂單預計延至2027年上半年出貨，法人預估2027年醫療業務有機會恢復40%至50%的成長。

paras_en: 2026-10-01 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – SmartTech (4551‑TW) shows markedly stronger operating momentum in the second half of the year, with July revenue up 10% month‑on‑month and 23.12% year‑on‑year, and August revenue reaching NT$8.02 billion, a 33.5% annual increase, marking ten consecutive months of positive growth. As AI server water‑cooling and semiconductor equipment parts begin to scale, the company’s growth focus is shifting from traditional automotive to technology businesses.

SmartTech entered a transformation harvest phase in 2026, with technology‑related revenue accounting for 16% of total in the first half, up from 10.4% in 2025, and in July the semiconductor and other segments broke the 20% threshold for the first time. By contrast, the automotive segment’s share continues to decline, with a long‑term target of around 40%.

AI server water‑cooling has become the new growth hotspot. Starting in July, SmartTech began shipping its UQD product – a key component for the Vera Rubin platform – and the Vietnam plant is expected to commence mass production by the end of Q3, further boosting operating momentum. As Vera Rubin NVL72 moves toward a 100% full‑liquid‑cooling design and both per‑container power density and per‑tray quick‑connect usage rise, demand for UQD is expected to outpace that for the GB200 and GB300 generations.

Analysts estimate that semiconductor and thermal‑management revenue in 2026 could double versus 2025, and grow nearly another 100% in 2027, potentially lifting its share to about 30%. If Vera Rubin and custom ASIC liquid‑cooling platforms scale together, UQD could become one of the fastest‑growing product lines in SmartTech’s technology business.

Semiconductor equipment parts are also expanding. SmartTech has obtained ASML certification and entered the EUV and DUV lithography machine automation parts market, supplying Brooks Instrument mass‑flow controllers (MFC) valve bodies and CMP components, further extending its technology product portfolio.

Profit performance is beginning to reflect the improved product mix. Q2 2026 revenue rose 25% year‑on‑year and gross margin climbed to 24.58%, a new high since 2023. However, front‑end costs at the Vietnam plant and sampling of new semiconductor products caused short‑term disruption, leading to an 11% quarter‑on‑quarter decline in operating profit for Q2.

The medical business lagged behind; in the first half of 2026, delayed shipments from customers reduced its revenue share to 8.7%, down 8.7% year‑on‑year, and the full‑year growth outlook was cut from 40% to 15%. Delayed orders are expected to ship in the first half of 2027, and analysts project medical revenue could rebound with 40%‑50% growth in 2027.

items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉台股力守五日線、鴻海分紅大成長、欣興砸百億標廠
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Index Holds 5‑Day Line, Foxconn’s Massive Dividend, Xinxing Wins Over NT$10 B Bridgestone Plant
paras:
台股盤前要聞

1.台股昨(30)日顯著回神，由電子權值股領軍反攻，面板雙虎更雙雙漲停，盤中一度飆漲748點，衝上48,379點，但隨著獲利了結賣壓出籠，台積電終場急殺，使得指數再度失守4萬8千點大關，留下上影線，但仍守住五日線，收在47,940.13點，上漲308.17點，成交量達8,756億元，較昨日放大。
2.鴻海(2317-TW)員工分紅昨(30)日入帳，受惠AI帶旺營收及獲利強勁成長，今年鴻海員工年度分紅整體平均水準，較去年大幅成長兩位數百分比以上，績效優異單位且表現突出的員工，有機會拿到百萬甚至更高的分紅獎金。
3.占地面積達1.9萬坪的新竹湖口輪胎大廠普利司通（Bridgestone）輪胎占地面積達1.9萬坪廠區，昨(30)日標售以100.8888億元，由IC載板及PCB廠欣興(3037-TW)拿下。
4.經濟部長龔明鑫出席大同(2371-TW)活動時致詞表示，AI時代不僅是算力與能源競爭，更是國力競賽。為打造完善的AI基礎設施，政府預計未來8年投入1000億元經費協助中小微企業導入算力，並規劃未來10年陸續上線25部大型天然氣機組提供2000億度電，他強調：「大同已經準備好了，經濟部與台灣產業也全都準備好了」，確保台灣算力發展與產業轉型電力供應無虞。
5.蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 即將於 10 月上市，市調機構 Counterpoint Research 初步預估，該款新機今年銷量可望達到約 600 萬支。不過，實際銷售表現仍取決於蘋果能否順利提升新機產能。
6.今年來漲幅已翻倍的群益半導體收益(00927-TW)公告第14次配息資訊，根據群益投信官網最新公告顯示，本次預估每單位配發2元，連4季配息金額都創新高。若以9月30日收盤價39.89元來推算，預估單次配息率5.03%、年化配息率約20.13%。本次除息日訂於10月19日，想參與00927本次領息的投資人，最晚需在10月16日買進，收益分配發放日則訂於11月13日。
7.台股昨(30)日因台積電尾盤急殺，漲幅顯著收斂、終場上漲308點，收在47,940點，失守4萬8千點大關，但仍力守五日線，三大法人今日全站買方，外資狂掃雙D族群，包括面板雙虎的群創及友達，以及記憶體族群的力積電與華邦電，四檔合計共26.4萬張。
8.AOI設備廠牧德科技(3563-TW)昨(30)日召開法人說明會，牧德指出，隨 AI 伺服器、高效能運算及高速傳輸等應用持續發展，高階 PCB 、 MSAP 、ABF 載板及半導體先進封裝等相關檢測需求同步提升，2026年對應AI需求的設備占比約70%，2027年整體營收將持續成長， 對應AI需求的設備占比將進一步成長到80-90%。
9.證交所、櫃買中心昨(30)日公告4檔處置股，包括飆股嘉晶(3016-TW)、蔚華科(3055-TW)、大甲(2221-TW)皆自今(1)日起關到10月12日，倚強科(3219-TW)則是處置到10月7日止。除了倚強科採每5分鐘撮合，其餘3檔股票皆為2分鐘撮合交易。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded sharply on the 30th, led by electronic heavyweight stocks. Both panel giants hit their daily limits up, pushing the index up 748 points mid‑session to 48,379 before profit‑taking pressure set in. TSMC’s sharp sell‑off at the close knocked the index back below the 48,000 mark, leaving a long upper shadow, but the 5‑day moving average held. The index closed at 47,940.13, up 308.17 points, with a turnover of NT$875.6 billion, larger than the previous day.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) recorded employee dividends on the 30th. Boosted by AI‑driven revenue and strong profit growth, the average annual dividend per employee rose by double‑digit percentages compared with last year. High‑performing units and outstanding staff could receive bonuses of one million NT$ or more.

Bridgestone’s new tire plant in Hsinchu’s Hukou district, covering 19,000 ping, was auctioned on the 30th for NT$10.08888 billion. The winning bidder was Xinxing (3037‑TW), a maker of IC substrates and PCBs.

Minister of Economic Affairs Gong Ming‑xin, speaking at a Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) event, said the AI era is not only a competition of computing power and energy but also of national strength. The government plans to invest NT$100 billion over the next eight years to help SMEs adopt computing capacity and to roll out 25 large natural‑gas power units over the next ten years, delivering 2,000 GWh of electricity. He emphasized, “Da‑Tong is ready, the Ministry and Taiwan’s industry are ready,” ensuring power supply for AI infrastructure and industrial transformation.

Apple (AAPL‑US) will launch its first foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, in October. Counterpoint Research preliminarily estimates sales of about 6 million units this year, though actual performance will depend on Apple’s ability to scale production.

Quanneng Semiconductor (00927‑TW), which has doubled its gains this year, announced its 14th dividend. The company proposes a NT$2 per unit payout, the highest quarterly dividend on record. Based on the September 30 closing price of NT$39.89, this implies a 5.03% single‑payment yield and an annualized yield of roughly 20.13%. The ex‑dividend date is set for October 19; investors must buy by October 16 to qualify, and the distribution date is November 13.

Taiwan stocks on the 30th narrowed gains after TSMC’s late‑session sell‑off, ending up 308 points at 47,940 and slipping below the 48,000 threshold, yet still defending the 5‑day line. All three major institutional investors were net buyers today, with foreign investors aggressively buying the “double‑D” group—panel leaders Innolux and AU Optronics, and memory players Powerchip and Winbond—totaling 264,000 contracts across four stocks.

AOI equipment maker Mude Technology (3563‑TW) held a corporate briefing on the 30th. The company said that as AI servers, high‑performance computing and high‑speed transmission applications expand, demand for advanced PCB, MSAP, ABF substrates and semiconductor advanced packaging testing will rise. By 2026, AI‑related equipment is expected to account for about 70% of its sales, climbing to 80‑90% in 2027 as overall revenue continues to grow.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the OTC market announced on the 30th that four stocks—high‑flyers Jia‑Jing (3016‑TW), Wei‑Hua Technology (3055‑TW) and Da‑Jia (2221‑TW)—will be suspended from trading starting the 1st until October 12. Yiqiang Technology (3219‑TW) will be suspended until October 7. Except for Yiqiang, which will trade on a 5‑minute matching cycle, the other three will use a 2‑minute matching cycle.
TSMC’s late‑session sell‑off erased the 48,000 level, but the index closed up 308 points with an upper shadow.
Foxconn’s annual dividend was credited today, up double‑digit percentages from last year, with top performers potentially receiving bonuses of one million NT$ or more.
AI‑driven expansion demand led Xinxing to secure the Bridgestone plant in Hukou, Hsinchu for over NT$10 billion.
Gong Ming‑xin: AI competition is also a national‑strength contest; the government is pouring NT$100 billion into computing power and expanding energy supply.
Counterpoint: Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo is projected to sell 6 million units this year.
This year’s gains have doubled; Quanneng (00927) generously pays NT$2 per quarter, yielding an annualized dividend rate of about 20%.
Taiwan stocks hold the 5‑day line; all three major institutions are net buyers; foreign investors sweep the double‑D group for a total of 264,000 contracts.
Mude’s revenue will keep growing, with AI‑related equipment share rising to 80‑90%.
Four soaring stocks will be halted starting tomorrow; three of them have risen over 40% in the past six trading days—Jia‑Jing, Wei‑Hua Technology, suspended until 10/12.

items.title: 凱基金擬辦現金增資最多250億元 7成以上將挹注凱基證券
items.title_en: KGI Fund Plans Up to NT$250 Billion Cash Capital Increase, Over 70% to Be Invested in KGI Securities
paras: 凱基金控(2883-TW)今(30)日董事會通過辦理現金增資發行普通股案，發行股數以不超過7.2億股為限，預計募資規模約新台幣200億元至250億元，實際募資金額將依最終訂定之發行價格而定，本次規劃將有七成以上資金投入凱基證券。
凱基金控表示，受惠於AI產業發展帶動台灣經濟成長，以及資本市場持續活絡，企業籌資、財富管理及金融商品交易需求穩健成長。為掌握市場發展契機及支應業務擴張所需資本，本次增資資金規劃將有七成以上投入凱基證券，進一步強化業務發展及市場競爭力。此舉除有助於擴大核心業務規模，更可提升集團資本運用效率及未來獲利成長動能。
凱基證券今年前8月各項業務動能持續強勁，累計稅後純益達227.54億元，續創歷年同期新高，較去年同期成長235%，年化股東權益報酬率達44%領先同業。在投資銀行業務方面，深耕AI及半導體等核心產業，前八月主辦承銷總金額市占率接近四成，穩居市場第一；財富管理業務持續拓展台灣及香港市場，營收維持強勁成長；衍生性商品及股票期權等交易業務亦靈活掌握市場機會，持續挹注獲利貢獻。
凱基金控表示，本次增資除支應凱基證券未來業務發展所需資本外，也展現集團持續優化資本配置、聚焦高成長及高資本效率業務的策略方向。未來將持續透過審慎且積極的資本管理，強化核心競爭優勢，提升集團整體獲利能力與股東價值。
本次現金增資發行新股將依相關法令規定辦理，其中10%保留由員工認購、10%採公開申購方式辦理，其餘80%由原股東按持股比例優先認購。實際發行價格將於本案向主管機關申報生效後，依相關法令規定及市場狀況訂定，並據以辦理後續繳款及發行作業。
paras_en: KGI Fund Holding (2883-TW) today (30th) had its board approve a cash capital increase by issuing common shares, limited to no more than 720 million shares, with an expected fundraising amount of about NT$200 billion to NT$250 billion. The actual amount raised will depend on the final issue price, and more than 70% of the funds will be allocated to KGI Securities.

KGI Fund Holding said it benefits from the AI industry driving Taiwan’s economic growth and a continuously active capital market, with steady growth in corporate financing, wealth management, and financial product trading demand. To seize market opportunities and fund business expansion, over 70% of the capital raised will be invested in KGI Securities to further strengthen business development and market competitiveness. This move will not only expand the core business scale but also improve the group’s capital utilization efficiency and future profit growth momentum.

KGI Securities reported strong business momentum in the first eight months of this year, with cumulative after‑tax net profit reaching NT$22.754 billion, a record high for the same period, up 235% year‑on‑year, and an annualized return on equity of 44%, leading peers. In investment banking, deep involvement in AI and semiconductor core industries yielded a market‑share of nearly 40% in underwriting volume for the first eight months, keeping it at the top of the market; wealth management continued to expand in Taiwan and Hong Kong with robust revenue growth; derivative and stock option trading also flexibly captured market opportunities, continuously contributing to profit.

KGI Fund Holding said the capital increase not only provides the capital needed for KGI Securities’ future business development but also demonstrates the group’s ongoing strategy of optimizing capital allocation and focusing on high‑growth, high‑capital‑efficiency businesses. Going forward, it will continue prudent yet proactive capital management to strengthen core competitive advantages and enhance overall group profitability and shareholder value.

The new shares from this cash capital increase will be issued in accordance with relevant regulations, with 10% reserved for employee subscription, 10% offered through a public offering, and the remaining 80% allocated to existing shareholders on a pro‑rata basis. The actual issue price will be set after the filing is approved by regulators, based on applicable laws and market conditions, and will guide subsequent payment and issuance procedures.

items.title_en: China Airlines Opens Flight Attendant Vacancies, Applications Start Oct 5, Earliest Reporting Mid‑January Next Year
paras: 華航(2610-TW)宣布啟動 2026 下半年徵才計畫，隨著陸續引進新世代機隊並擴張全球航網，預計招募合計逾百名客艙組員和貨運營運人員。
華航表示，積極充實空服團隊，本次客艙組員招募將於 10 月 5 日至 12 日開放報名，初試和複試預計分別在 11 月 7 日及 11 月 14 日舉行，報名者須具備教育部認可學士學位以上學歷，以及多益聽讀 600 分以上或同等英語成績，錄取者最快明年 1 月中旬起陸續報到。
同時，華航深耕航空貨運市場，同步招募貨運營運人員，報名時間自 10 月 1 日起至 10 月 14 日，職務內容涵蓋管理全球客貨機航班貨運作業，包括平衡表製作和盤櫃規劃等。
華航居台灣航空貨運市場領先地位，正積極強化業務競爭力，今年已率先推出生成式 AI 貨運客服，並進一步擴充智慧訂位等功能，朝更高效率的工作模式邁進。
華航擁有完善教育訓練制度和職涯發展環境，提供員工和眷屬優待機票、社團活動、心理諮商和運動活動等，兼顧專業成長與生活品質，為配合營運發展需求，也將陸續開放各項職缺招募。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) announced the launch of its 2026 second‑half recruitment drive. With the gradual introduction of a new‑generation fleet and the expansion of its global network, the airline plans to hire more than one hundred cabin crew members and cargo operation staff.

China Airlines said it is actively strengthening its flight‑attendant team. This cabin‑crew recruitment will accept applications from October 5 to October 12, with the first and second interviews scheduled for November 7 and November 14 respectively. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher recognized by the Ministry of Education and have a TOEIC listening‑reading score of at least 600 or an equivalent English qualification. Successful candidates could begin reporting as early as mid‑January next year.

At the same time, China Airlines, which is deepening its presence in the air‑cargo market, is also hiring cargo operation personnel. Applications are open from October 1 to October 14, and the roles cover management of global passenger‑and‑cargo flight cargo operations, including balance‑sheet preparation and container‑planning.

China Airlines, the leader in Taiwan’s air‑cargo market, is actively enhancing its competitive edge. This year it pioneered a generative‑AI‑powered cargo customer‑service system and is further expanding smart‑booking functions, moving toward a more efficient work model.

China Airlines offers a comprehensive education‑training system and career‑development environment, providing employees and their families with preferential tickets, club activities, psychological counseling, and sports programs. Balancing professional growth with quality of life, the airline will continue to open various job openings to meet operational development needs.

items.title: 資服業新兵報到 藍新資訊以AI維運平台搶占高門檻利基市場
items.title_en: New Entrant in the IT Services Sector: Blue New Information Seizes High‑Barrier Niche Market with AI Operations Platform
paras: 資訊服務業又有新兵報到，藍新資訊(6938-TW)將於10月1日舉辦上櫃前業績發表會，預計10月中旬掛牌上櫃，總經理楊璦如表示，已形成「建置帶動維護維運、維護維運帶動優化」的服務循環，過去三年維護維運合約年複合成長率約14.5%，三年平均合約存續率超過90%，持續性收入占營收比重達40%，成營運穩定的基礎，後續將聚焦客戶推動AI算力導入、混合雲架構升級和零信任資安治理的龐大商機。
藍新資訊從大型主機出發，主要服務ERP、MES、HIS、金融行業交易系統和資料庫等關鍵應用所需的資訊運作平台，涵蓋雲端、儲存、網路資安和AI，並由規劃、建置一路承接維護與維運，目前服務客戶超過400家，今年前8月合併營收4.29億元，年增26.24%。
藍新資訊說明，業務門檻偏高，在於政府機關、金融行業及大型企業的核心系統涉及跨平台架構、既有系統相容性和營運不中斷要求，供應商除須具備規劃和建置能力，更需長期累積實際維運經驗，而客戶一旦導入即不易更換，形成有別於一般系統整合商的競爭門檻。
技術面上，藍新資訊專業工程團隊逾90人，累積超過600張技術認證，集中於大型核心主機、雲端虛擬化、AI數據存儲和資訊安全四大領域，並與IBM、NetApp、HPE、Dell、Cisco、Palo Alto、F5及Veeam等國際原廠建立長期合作關係，多次取得原廠傑出夥伴獎項。
為強化AI布局，藍新資訊於去年已成立智能應用發展部，並取得多項AI伺服器、高階GPU運算平台及AI商業應用導入的銷售實績，今年上半年占營收比重快速成長至8%。
藍新科進一步說明，不同於單純銷售AI伺服器，藍新資訊將AI布局定位為既有企業IT架構的延伸，未來將聚焦政府、金融機構與大型企業核心系統，持續擴大發展高門檻、高黏著度的利基市場。
paras_en: Information services welcome a new player as Blue New Information (6938‑TW) will hold a pre‑listing performance briefing on October 1 and plans to list on the OTC market in mid‑October. General manager Yang Airu said the company has established a service cycle of “building drives maintenance and operations, maintenance and operations drive optimization.” Over the past three years, maintenance‑and‑operations contracts grew at a compound annual rate of about 14.5%, with an average contract renewal rate exceeding 90%. Recurring revenue now accounts for 40% of total sales, providing a stable operating foundation. Going forward, the firm will focus on large opportunities in AI compute adoption, hybrid‑cloud upgrades and zero‑trust security governance for its customers.

Blue New Information started from large‑scale mainframes, primarily providing the information‑operations platforms needed for critical applications such as ERP, MES, HIS, financial transaction systems and databases. Its offerings span cloud, storage, network security and AI, covering everything from planning and construction to ongoing maintenance and operations. The company now serves more than 400 customers and recorded combined revenue of NT$429 million for the first eight months of this year, a year‑over‑year increase of 26.24%.

The company explained that the high entry barrier stems from the core systems of government agencies, financial institutions and large enterprises, which involve cross‑platform architectures, legacy system compatibility and uninterrupted operation requirements. Suppliers must not only have planning and implementation capabilities but also long‑term, hands‑on operational experience. Once a client adopts the solution, switching vendors is difficult, creating a competitive moat distinct from typical system integrators.

On the technical side, Blue New Information’s professional engineering team exceeds 90 staff and holds more than 600 technical certifications, focusing on four major domains: large‑scale core mainframes, cloud virtualization, AI data storage and information security. The firm has long‑term partnerships with international vendors such as IBM, NetApp, HPE, Dell, Cisco, Palo Alto, F5 and Veeam, and has repeatedly earned outstanding partner awards from these manufacturers.

To strengthen its AI positioning, Blue New Information established an Intelligent Application Development Department last year and has secured multiple sales of AI servers, high‑end GPU computing platforms and AI business‑application implementations. In the first half of this year, AI‑related revenue grew rapidly to represent 8% of total sales.

Blue New Information further clarified that, unlike pure AI‑server sales, its AI strategy is framed as an extension of existing enterprise IT architectures. Going forward, the company will concentrate on core systems of governments, financial institutions and large enterprises, continuously expanding its high‑barrier, high‑stickiness niche market.

items.title: 全球央行掀去美元購金潮 兆豐009832掌握黃金槓桿爆發力
items.title_en: Global Central Banks Spark Gold Buying Wave, Mega Financial 009832 Captures Gold Leverage Power
paras: 全球金融市場迎來多元配置新時代！在去美元化趨勢成形、地緣政治避險情緒升溫，以及美國聯準會重啟降息循環等推波助瀾下，全球央行自 2020 年起掀起強勁的「購金熱潮」。法人指出，隨著實質利率走低與地緣政治風險加劇，國際頂尖投行對金價後市看法極度樂觀，摩根大通預估 2027 年金價將上看每盎司 6,300 美元，更有中小型券商喊出 8,600 美元的天價。看好黃金產業槓桿效應，兆豐投信推出全台首檔黃金礦業 ETF—兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF(009832-TW)。
兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF 經理人吳朋鴻表示，黃金具備「避險資產首選、長期儲存價值、無主權違約風險」三大核心特性。自 2008 年金融海嘯後，美國經歷四次量化寬鬆(QE)，導致美元購買力大幅縮水；加上俄烏戰爭與中東地緣政治衝突等因素，許多新興市場央行(如中國、土耳其、巴西)為防範美元資產遭凍結，紛紛減少美債與美元儲備，進而大舉轉向增持無法憑空印製的黃金。
根據 2026 年中央銀行黃金儲備調查，高達 84% 受訪央行預計未來五年將繼續提高黃金佔總儲備的比率。歐洲央行(ECB)資料亦顯示，歐洲各央行黃金配置比率已從 20% 飆升至 27%，在央行買盤長線護盤與稀缺性撐腰下，奠定了黃金資產的長線戰略地位。
面對黃金投資熱潮，吳朋鴻強調，投資黃金已從 1.0 的實體金條(保管難、無利息)與 2.0 的黃金存折/期貨 ETF(交易成本高、無配息)，演進至 3.0 的「黃金礦業 ETF」。
黃金礦業股票具備獨特的「營運槓桿效應」，以「麵包店」概念舉例，黃金價格如同麵包售價，金礦公司則是生產麵包的企業。當國際金價上漲，而開採成本控制得宜時，企業獲利呈倍數擴大，帶動公司 EPS 與評價面(P/E)雙提升。
歷史數據驗證，在 2019 年至 2025 年間，國際金價平均年漲 20.6%，但 009832 追蹤的「NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數」年均漲幅達 35.5%；2025 年金價大漲 64.6% 時，該指數更飆升 163.5%，展現遠高於金價的價格彈性與爆發力。
009832 追蹤 NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數精選 55 檔在美國掛牌、市值達標(7.5 億美元以上)的高純度金銀龍頭企業，黃金約占 90.2%、白銀占 9.8%。
009832 前十大成分股囊括全球三大黃金生產商(如道瓊成分股 Newmont、Barric 等)，同時納入兼具 AI 與光伏剛性需求的白銀龍頭。更特別的是，成分股包含被譽為「礦業銀行家」的貴金屬權利金與金屬分潤公司(如 Wheaton)。這類公司提供礦商融資，並得以極高折扣價(如以每盎司 400 美元取得市場價 4,000 美元的黃金)獲取成品，在金價多頭格局下，獲利更具爆發性成長力。
paras_en: Global financial markets are ushering in a new era of diversified allocation! Driven by the formation of a de‑dollarisation trend, heightened geopolitical‑risk hedging sentiment, and the U.S. Federal Reserve’s restart of a rate‑cut cycle, central banks worldwide have launched a strong “gold‑buying frenzy” since 2020. Analysts note that with real rates falling and geopolitical risks intensifying, top international investment banks are extremely bullish on gold’s outlook – JPMorgan projects gold to reach $6,300 per ounce by 2027, and some boutique brokers even quote a sky‑high $8,600. Seeing the leverage effect of the gold industry, Mega Financial Investment Trust introduced Taiwan’s first gold‑mining ETF – Mega US Gold Mining ETF (009832‑TW).

Mega US Gold Mining ETF manager Wu Peng‑hong says gold possesses three core attributes: “the top‑choice hedge asset, long‑term store of value, and no sovereign default risk.” Since the 2008 financial crisis, the U.S. has undergone four rounds of quantitative easing, eroding the dollar’s purchasing power. Coupled with the Russia‑Ukraine war and Middle‑East geopolitical tensions, many emerging‑market central banks (e.g., China, Turkey, Brazil) have reduced U.S. Treasury and dollar reserves to avoid asset freezes, shifting heavily toward gold, which cannot be printed out of thin air.

According to the 2026 central‑bank gold‑reserve survey, a staggering 84% of respondents expect to increase gold’s share of total reserves over the next five years. ECB data also show that European central banks’ gold allocation has jumped from 20% to 27%, cementing gold’s long‑term strategic position under sustained central‑bank buying and scarcity support.

Facing the gold‑investment boom, Wu Peng‑hong emphasizes that gold investing has evolved from 1.0 physical bars (hard to store, no interest) and 2.0 gold accounts/futures ETFs (high transaction costs, no dividends) to 3.0 “gold‑mining ETFs.”

Gold‑mining stocks exhibit a unique operating‑leverage effect. Using a “bakery” analogy, gold price is like the price of bread, and mining companies are the bakers. When international gold prices rise while extraction costs are well‑controlled, profits multiply, boosting both EPS and valuation multiples (P/E).

Historical data show that from 2019 to 2025, global gold prices rose an average of 20.6% per year, whereas the “NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index” tracked by 009832 posted a 35.5% annual gain. In 2025, when gold surged 64.6%, the index jumped 163.5%, demonstrating price elasticity and explosive growth far exceeding the metal itself.

009832 tracks the NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index, which selects 55 high‑purity gold‑silver leaders listed in the U.S. with market caps above $750 million. The portfolio is roughly 90.2% gold and 9.8% silver.

The fund’s top ten holdings include the world’s three largest gold producers (e.g., Newmont and Barrick, both Dow Jones components) and silver leaders with AI and photovoltaic demand. Notably, the basket also contains precious‑metal royalty and streaming firms (e.g., Wheaton), dubbed “mining bankers.” These companies finance miners and acquire metal at deep discounts (e.g., $400 per ounce for market‑price $4,000 gold), delivering explosive profit potential in a bullish gold environment.

items.title: AI支出續強勁 美銀點名美光、輝達、英特爾等「贏家」
items.title_en: AI Spending Remains Strong, BofA Names Micron, Nvidia, Intel and Others as Winners
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，今年只剩下3個月，對華爾街而言，這意味著市場開始展望明年的經濟、股市與各產業表現。分析師提出的重要觀點帶動相關股票走勢並不罕見，尤其當這些看法同時伴隨目標價與獲利預估上調時，更容易對股價產生影響。
以下是近期第一批值得關注的前瞻性市場觀點之一，來自美國銀行半導體分析師Vivek Arya，聚焦於AI熱潮核心企業的動能型科技股。
Arya指出，AI資本支出有很大機會高於許多市場預期，並成為多檔股票超乎預期的順風力量。
談到AI基礎設施前景，Arya表示，「我們將2026年至2030年AI資料中心系統的整體潛在市場(TAM)預估，從原先的1.8兆美元、年增33%，上調至2.2兆美元，年增達40%。」
「消費者與企業採用AI代理工具形成的良性循環、公有與私有AI實驗室之間的競爭，以及晶片供應有限，都可能讓未來幾年的AI支出保持強勁。」
他表示，先進AI模型若放慢開發進度或增加安全防護措施，可能反而增加而非降低運算需求，並讓更多需求從訓練轉向成長速度更快的推理運算。
同時，頂尖晶片股的估值相較每股盈餘(EPS)成長預估仍具吸引力。費城半導體指數目前的預估本益比為21倍，比ChatGPT問世以來24倍的中位數本益比低12%，而EPS成長潛力預估則超過40%。

看好的晶片股贏家

在Arya修正後的AI投資論點下，多檔股票都具備看多條件。
Arya寫道，「從歷史來看，第四曆季(CQ4)與第一曆季(CQ1)是持有晶片股表現最好的兩個季。2010年至2025年期間，晶片股相較標普500指數的中位數超額報酬為300至500個基點。」
他指出目前最看好個股，以及近期催化因素包括：

輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)：加大股票回購，以及多場GTC科技大會活動。
英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)：AI代理帶動CPU需求，以及市場期待其晶圓代工業務取得新訂單。
美光(Micron)(MU-US)：預計12月9日起啟動股票回購。
邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)：10月6日舉行分析師日，以及XPU出貨量提升。
科林研發(Lam Research)(LRCX-US)：有望在記憶體與邏輯晶片領域提高市占率。


此外，美銀也持續看好AMD(AMD-US)、應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)、亞德諾半導體(Analog Devices)(ADI-US)與安森美(On Semiconductor)(ON-US)。
同時持續關注博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)。美銀目前給予該股買進評級，主要是看好博通具吸引力的估值。並指出，博通「12月公布第四財季業績時，也可能宣布加大股票回購。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that with only three months left in the year, Wall Street is beginning to look ahead to next year’s economy, stock market and sector performance. It is not uncommon for analysts’ key viewpoints to drive related stock moves, especially when those views are accompanied by target‑price and earnings‑forecast upgrades, which can more easily affect share prices.

One of the first forward‑looking market viewpoints to watch recently comes from Bank of America semiconductor analyst Vivek Arya, who focuses on momentum‑driven tech stocks at the core of the AI boom.
Arya said AI capital spending has a high chance of exceeding many market expectations and will become a tailwind that pushes several stocks beyond forecasts.

Discussing the outlook for AI infrastructure, Arya stated, “We have revised our estimate of the total addressable market (TAM) for AI data‑center systems from 2026 to 2030, raising it from the original $1.8 trillion with a 33% annual growth rate to $2.2 trillion with a 40% annual growth rate.”

He added that a virtuous cycle of consumer and enterprise adoption of AI agents, competition between public and private AI labs, and limited chip supply could keep AI spending robust for the coming years.

He noted that if the development of advanced AI models slows or more safety safeguards are added, compute demand could actually increase rather than decrease, shifting more demand from training to faster‑growing inference workloads.

At the same time, valuations for top chip stocks remain attractive relative to projected earnings‑per‑share (EPS) growth. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index currently trades at a forward P/E of 21×, about 12% below the post‑ChatGPT median of 24×, while EPS growth potential is estimated at over 40%.
Chip‑stock winners under Arya’s revised AI investment thesis have multiple stocks with bullish upside.

Arya wrote, “Historically, the fourth calendar quarter (CQ4) and the first calendar quarter (CQ1) have been the two best quarters for holding chip stocks. From 2010 to 2025, chip stocks have delivered median excess returns of 300 to 500 basis points over the S&P 500.”
He highlighted the individual stocks he is most bullish on, along with near‑term catalysts:

Nvidia (NVDA‑US): larger share‑repurchase program and multiple GTC technology‑conference events. Intel (INTC‑US): AI agents driving CPU demand and market expectations of new wafer‑fab orders. Micron (MU‑US): planned share‑repurchase program starting Dec 9. Marvell (MRVL‑US): analyst day on Oct 6 and rising XPU shipments. Lam Research (LRCX‑US): potential market‑share gains in memory and logic chips.

In addition, BofA continues to favor AMD (AMD‑US), Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Analog Devices (ADI‑US) and ON Semiconductor (ON‑US). It also remains watchful of Broadcom (AVGO‑US), which BofA rates as a buy due to its attractive valuation and notes that Broadcom may announce an expanded share‑repurchase program when it reports fourth‑quarter results in December.

items.title: AI資料中心搶電！Bloom Energy今年暴漲219% 克雷默仍看好但喊「先別追」
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Scramble for Power! Bloom Energy Soars 219% This Year, Cramer Still Bullish but Says “Don’t Chase Yet”
paras: CNBC知名財經節目主持人克雷默(Jim Cramer)週三表示，在AI資料中心建設帶動的「表後供電」(behind-the-meter)市場中，Bloom Energy (BE-US)仍是他最看好的投資方式，但目前並不是他願意立即進場追價的時點。克雷默認為，若投資人希望掌握AI基礎建設背後快速增加的電力需求，Bloom Energy仍是他的首選標的之一，長期而言股價未來幾年仍可能進一步走高。
Bloom Energy今年股價已大漲219%，其中9月單月上漲34%，主要受到AI資料中心建設加速及現場燃料電池需求升溫帶動。該股自克雷默今年2月介紹這家公司以來，股價幾乎已翻倍。
Bloom Energy的核心技術是模組化固態氧化物燃料電池系統，可部署在資料中心等大型用電設施附近，直接提供主要或備援電力，不必完全依賴公共電網。系統可將燃料轉換為電力而不透過傳統燃燒方式發電，因此能以模組化方式擴充，成為AI資料中心在等待電網接入期間的替代供電方案。
AI資料中心目前面臨的核心限制之一就是電力。資料中心的規模通常以需要多少GW的持續電力來衡量，隨著AI運算需求增加，電力供應已成為決定資料中心能否擴建的重要因素。Bloom Energy的現場供電系統則主打縮短取得電力所需的時間，避免業者必須等待數年才能完成新的電網連接。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)就是其中一個案例。Bloom Energy表示，公司曾在55天內完成向甲骨文一座資料中心供電的部署，遠低於傳統大型電力基礎建設可能需要的時間。兩家公司今年4月也進一步擴大合作，甲骨文旗下AI及雲端基礎建設計畫將採購最多2.8GW的Bloom燃料電池系統，其中初始1.2GW容量已簽約並開始部署。
Bloom Energy的財務表現也反映AI資料中心需求的快速成長。公司第2季營收達約10.7億美元，年增166%，明顯超越市場預期；調整後每股盈餘為0.78美元，幾乎是市場原先預期的兩倍。公司並上調2026年全年營收預測至39億至42億美元，中間值約40.5億美元，意味著全年營收規模可望較前一年翻倍。
Bloom Energy在2025年全年營收已達20.2億美元，較2024年的14.7億美元增加37.3%，公司當時表示，AI資料中心產業的需求是推動營收創新高的重要因素。
Bloom Energy表示，包括大型超大規模雲端服務商、超過12家neocloud業者及AI實驗室在內的客戶，都已對其技術表示支持或完成驗證，顯示現場供電市場正從早期測試階段逐步進入商業部署。
Bloom Energy近期也持續強化AI電力布局。公司9月推出Power Connect技術，主打將現場電力安裝時間縮短超過40%；此外，公司持續推動800V DC-native電力架構，針對AI資料中心高密度運算所需的電力環境，降低傳統交流電轉換過程可能造成的損耗及設備需求。
Bloom Energy同時面臨來自其他表後發電技術的競爭，包括GE Vernova (GEV-US)的大型燃氣渦輪機。與Bloom Energy的模組化燃料電池不同，GE Vernova主要透過大型燃氣渦輪機提供電力，兩家公司都試圖搶攻AI資料中心快速增加的現場供電需求。
隨著AI資料中心建設規模不斷擴大，電力供應的重要性也從AI產業的周邊議題逐漸轉變為核心基礎建設。Bloom Energy今年大幅增加的營收、甲骨文的大型訂單，以及其他AI業者的採用，均使市場更加關注現場發電能否成為傳統電網之外的重要供電來源。
不過，克雷默也提醒投資人不要因看好AI電力需求就追高Bloom Energy。按照當時市場預期，Bloom Energy股價約相當於今年預估每股盈餘的108倍，以及明年預估每股盈餘的59倍，估值已反映相當高的成長預期。
因此，克雷默雖然仍將Bloom Energy視為AI電力需求的首選投資方式，但他的看法並非建議投資人立即買進，而是等待股價回檔後再評估長期布局機會。Bloom Energy預計10月27日公布第3季財報，屆時營收、訂單及AI資料中心相關業務進展，將成為市場觀察公司成長能否延續的重要指標。
paras_en: CNBC’s well‑known finance show host Jim Cramer said on Wednesday that in the behind‑the‑meter market driven by AI data‑center construction, Bloom Energy (BE‑US) remains his top investment pick, but it’s not a time he’s willing to jump in and buy at current prices. Cramer believes that investors looking to capture the rapidly growing electricity demand behind AI infrastructure should still consider Bloom Energy as one of his preferred targets, and the stock could keep climbing over the next few years.

Bloom Energy’s stock has already surged 219% this year, including a 34% jump in September, mainly fueled by accelerated AI data‑center builds and rising on‑site fuel‑cell demand. Since Cramer first highlighted the company in February, the share price has almost doubled.

Bloom Energy’s core technology is a modular solid‑oxide fuel‑cell system that can be deployed near large‑load facilities such as data centers, providing primary or backup power without relying entirely on the public grid. The system converts fuel to electricity without traditional combustion, allowing modular expansion and serving as an alternative power source while AI data centers wait for grid connections.

One of the key constraints facing AI data centers today is electricity. Data‑center size is often measured by the gigawatts of continuous power required, and as AI compute demand rises, power supply becomes a decisive factor for expansion. Bloom Energy’s on‑site power solution promises to shorten the time needed to secure electricity, avoiding years‑long waits for new grid hookups.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) is one example. Bloom Energy said it completed power deployment to an Oracle data center in just 55 days, far quicker than the timeline typical for large‑scale grid projects. In April the two companies expanded their partnership, with Oracle’s AI and cloud infrastructure program set to purchase up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel‑cell systems, of which an initial 1.2 GW has already been contracted and is being rolled out.

Bloom Energy’s financials also reflect the rapid growth of AI data‑center demand. Q2 revenue reached roughly $1.07 billion, up 166% year‑over‑year and well ahead of expectations; adjusted EPS was $0.78, nearly double market forecasts. The company lifted its 2026 full‑year revenue outlook to $3.9‑$4.2 billion, with a midpoint of about $4.05 billion, implying revenue could double from the prior year.

For the full year 2025, Bloom Energy reported $2.02 billion in revenue, a 37.3% increase from $1.47 billion in 2024, noting that demand from the AI data‑center sector was a key driver of the record‑high sales.

Bloom Energy said that customers—including large hyperscale cloud providers, more than 12 neocloud operators, and AI labs—have either endorsed or completed validation of its technology, indicating that the on‑site power market is moving from early testing toward commercial deployment.

Bloom Energy has also been strengthening its AI‑power footprint. In September the company launched Power Connect technology, claiming to cut on‑site installation time by over 40%; it is also advancing an 800 V DC‑native power architecture to reduce losses and equipment needs associated with traditional AC conversion for high‑density AI compute workloads.

Bloom Energy also faces competition from other behind‑the‑meter power technologies, such as GE Vernova’s (GEV‑US) large gas turbines. Unlike Bloom’s modular fuel cells, GE Vernova relies on big gas turbines, but both firms are vying for the fast‑growing on‑site power demand of AI data centers.

As AI data‑center construction scales up, power supply is shifting from a peripheral issue to a core infrastructure concern for the AI industry. Bloom Energy’s sharply higher revenue this year, Oracle’s sizable order, and adoption by other AI players are drawing market attention to whether on‑site generation can become a major power source beyond the traditional grid.

However, Cramer cautioned investors not to chase Bloom Energy simply because he is bullish on AI power demand. Based on current market expectations, the stock trades at roughly 108 times this year’s estimated EPS and 59 times next year’s estimate, reflecting a very high growth premium already priced in.

Thus, while Cramer still views Bloom Energy as his top pick for AI power demand, he does not recommend buying immediately. He suggests waiting for a price pull‑back before evaluating a long‑term position. Bloom Energy is slated to release its Q3 results on October 27, when revenue, orders and AI‑data‑center‑related progress will be key gauges of continued growth.

items.title: 柴油價格飆史高！川普承認「每天」討論出口禁令　Fed調查：高價恐需至少1年才回落
items.title_en: Diesel Prices Surge to Historic High! Trump Says He Discusses Export Ban "Every Day"; Fed Survey: Prices May Not Ease for At Least a Year
paras: 最新數據顯示，美國柴油價格攀漲至每加侖6.53美元，打破2022年創下的歷史新高紀錄，過去一年漲幅超過四成，嚴重衝擊物流、農業等實體經濟。面對11月期中選舉的民意壓力，美國總統川普周三(9月30日)說，「每天都在磋商」是否禁止柴油出口來壓價。
川普承認，切斷出口恐對汽油價格造成負面溢出，但能確實降低柴油成本。他將油價暴漲歸因於俄烏雙方頻繁襲擊彼此能源設施。
美國能源部長賴特指出，中東局勢惡化令柴油出口受阻，全球燃料供應鏈面臨廣泛中斷。除考慮全面出口禁令、推動煉油廠自願限產外，白宮也研擬擴大免稅柴油銷售，並敦促歐盟釋放應急儲備。
然而，行政干預能否奏效備受質疑。達拉斯聯準銀行最新調查顯示，近半受訪的油氣企業高管預期，柴油價格至少需要四個季度才能回落至2025年常態。業界形容「柴油是實體經濟的母乳」，通膨連環衝擊才剛開始，俄羅斯柴油短期內亦難重返市場。
Rystad Energy首席經濟學家Claudio Galimberti指出，歐洲與拉美買家高度依賴美國貨源彌補中東缺口，禁令將引爆海外油價，且墨西哥灣沿岸煉廠亦可能因出口受阻被迫降載，反而推高本土汽油與航空煤油成本。
與此同時，聯邦措施未定之際，地方已率先自救。德州州長Greg Abbott周一(9月28日)宣布全州進入「災難狀態」，放寬環保規定，允許農用染料柴油合法加注於公路貨車，並放寬軸重限制，以阻斷物價全面外溢。
paras_en: The latest data show U.S. diesel prices have climbed to $6.53 per gallon, breaking the record high set in 2022. Over the past year the price has risen more than 40%, severely hitting logistics, agriculture and other real‑economy sectors. Facing public‑opinion pressure ahead of the November midterm elections, President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (Sept. 30) that "we are negotiating every day" whether to ban diesel exports to push prices down.

Trump acknowledged that cutting off exports could have a negative spillover on gasoline prices, but it would definitely lower diesel costs. He blamed the sharp rise in fuel prices on the frequent attacks by both Russia and Ukraine on each other's energy facilities.

U.S. Energy Secretary Jennifer Granholm said the worsening situation in the Middle East is disrupting diesel exports and causing widespread interruptions in the global fuel supply chain. In addition to considering a full export ban and encouraging refineries to voluntarily cut production, the White House is also drafting plans to expand tax‑free diesel sales and urging the EU to release emergency reserves.

However, the effectiveness of administrative intervention is being questioned. A recent survey by the Dallas Fed shows that nearly half of the oil‑and‑gas executives surveyed expect diesel prices will need at least four quarters to fall back to a 2025‑type normal level. The industry describes diesel as "the mother’s milk of the real economy," warning that the inflationary shock is only just beginning and that Russian diesel is unlikely to return to the market in the short term.

Claudio Galimberti, chief economist at Rystad Energy, noted that European and Latin American buyers are heavily reliant on U.S. supplies to fill the gap left by the Middle East, and a ban would trigger overseas oil price spikes. He also warned that Gulf Coast refineries could be forced to cut runs because of export constraints, which would in turn push up domestic gasoline and jet‑fuel costs.

Meanwhile, before any federal measures are finalized, states are already taking action. Texas Governor Greg Abbott announced on Monday (Sept. 28) that the entire state is entering a "disaster emergency" status, loosening environmental regulations to allow agricultural dye‑diesel to be legally blended into highway trucks and relaxing axle‑weight limits in an effort to prevent price spillovers across the board.

items.title: 美光加碼2027會計年度資本支出無塵室擴建瞄準2028年後供給
items.title_en: Micron Increases FY2027 Capital Expenditure for Clean‑Room Expansion Aiming at Post‑2028 Supply
paras: 2026年10月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美光Micron Technology(MU-US)持續擴大記憶體產能布局，隨AI帶動DRAM、HBM與資料中心儲存需求升溫，公司已將2027會計年度資本支出提高至原先規畫以上，新增支出主要集中在無塵室建設，為2028年底及之後的產能需求預作準備。
美光目前正擴充全球多數生產基地，並在美國與日本建置新產能。其中，美國愛達荷州新廠預計2027年年中開始產出首批矽晶圓，不過管理層指出，新廠從開始生產到形成具規模的市場供給，仍需經過數季產能爬坡，因此短期供給增加速度有限。
在2027會計年度資本支出規畫中，美光表示，增加部分主要用於加速無塵室空間建設，大部分新增建設支出所對應的產能，要到2028年底及之後才會陸續到位。公司也強調，無塵室建成並不等於立即增加DRAM bit供給，後續仍需依市場需求決定設備進駐與實際產能建置速度。
管理層指出，目前記憶體產業最大的供給限制之一就是無塵室空間。AI需求快速增長的速度，明顯快於晶圓廠從規畫、興建、認證到設備進駐所需時間，即使新廠開始產出晶圓，真正轉化為有意義的市場供給仍需數季。
需求端也讓美光更有信心提前擴建。公司表示，AI帶來的記憶體需求已不再只來自GPU加速器，Agentic AI工作負載增加，也開始推升CPU伺服器對DDR、LPDDR及SSD的需求。管理層指出，伺服器出貨目前呈現高雙位數成長，DRAM正逐漸成為AI資料中心的重要供給限制之一。
長期供應協議也提高了美光對未來需求的能見度。公司目前已簽署26份長期供應協議，涵蓋DRAM與NAND，且2027會計年度超過75%的出貨量已獲客戶承諾，產能配置討論也開始延伸至2028年。部分長約甚至已涵蓋2030年之後，讓公司在擴建無塵室與安排未來產能時，能更貼近實際需求。
另一方面，HBM比重持續提高，也讓產能壓力進一步加大。美光指出，產品組合將由HBM3E轉向HBM4，並於2027年較後段進一步轉向HBM4E。新一代HBM的trade ratio持續提高，代表相同晶圓產能可轉換出的DRAM bit數下降，也會壓抑整體供給成長。
在這樣的供需結構下，美光一方面加速無塵室建設，另一方面仍會依照市場需求決定後續設備進駐與產能開出節奏，資本支出方向也從單純擴產，轉向提前為2028年後的AI記憶體需求預留空間。
