paras_en: October 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Micron Technology (MU‑US) continues to expand its memory capacity footprint as AI drives hotter demand for DRAM, HBM and data‑center storage. The company has raised its FY2027 capital spending above the original plan, with the additional outlay focused mainly on clean‑room construction to prepare for capacity needs at the end of 2028 and beyond.

Micron is currently expanding most of its global fabs and adding new capacity in the United States and Japan. The new plant in Idaho is slated to ship its first silicon wafers in mid‑2027, but management notes that it will take several quarters of ramp‑up before the factory can deliver sizable market supply, so short‑term supply growth will be limited.

In its FY2027 capital‑expenditure plan, Micron says the increase will be used primarily to accelerate clean‑room space build‑out, with most of the new construction capacity coming online only after the end of 2028. The company also stresses that a completed clean‑room does not instantly translate into more DRAM bits; equipment installation and actual production scaling will still depend on market demand.

Management points out that clean‑room space is one of the biggest supply constraints in the memory industry today. The rapid rise in AI demand outpaces the time needed for a fab to go from planning and construction to certification and equipment installation, meaning that even when a new plant starts outputting wafers, it will take several quarters before that translates into meaningful market supply.

Demand gives Micron confidence to expand ahead of schedule. The firm notes that AI‑driven memory demand now comes not only from GPU accelerators but also from growing Agentic AI workloads, which are boosting CPU‑server demand for DDR, LPDDR and SSDs. Management says server shipments are currently growing at high double‑digit rates, and DRAM is becoming an increasingly critical supply bottleneck for AI data centers.

Long‑term supply agreements have also improved Micron’s visibility into future demand. The company has signed 26 long‑term contracts covering DRAM and NAND, and more than 75% of FY2027 shipments are already committed by customers, with capacity‑allocation discussions extending into 2028. Some contracts even cover periods beyond 2030, allowing Micron to align clean‑room expansion and future capacity planning more closely with actual demand.

On the other hand, the share of HBM in Micron’s portfolio keeps rising, adding further capacity pressure. Micron says its product mix will shift from HBM3E to HBM4, and later in FY2027 move toward HBM4E. The trade‑off ratio of the new‑generation HBM continues to increase, meaning that the same wafer capacity yields fewer DRAM bits, which will suppress overall supply growth.

Given this supply‑demand structure, Micron is accelerating clean‑room construction while still basing equipment installation and production rollout on market demand. Its capital‑spending focus is shifting from pure capacity expansion to pre‑positioning space for AI memory needs after 2028.

items.title: 只花22天！Muse在美超越ChatGPT成最快達成500萬次下載量AI應用程式
items.title_en: Only 22 Days! Meta’s Muse Beats ChatGPT in the U.S. to Become the Fastest AI App to Reach 5 Million Downloads
paras: 最新數據顯示，Meta的AI助理Muse上線約三週，下載量突破500萬次，成為美國 App Store免費榜榜首，並連12天居榜首位置。
根據市調機構 Sensor Tower高級洞察分析師Kara Lee預測，Muse下載量在9月30日(問世第22天)突破500萬次，達到這一規模所用時間明顯短於ChatGPT(56天)、Grok(103天)與Claude(492天)。
Sensor Tower數據顯示，美國市場僅有23款應用程式在上線22天內下載量超過500萬次。其中約85%為行動遊戲，如《Fortnite》《Pokémon GO》《Candy Crush》；非遊戲類僅3款：Disney+、HBO Max與Threads，同期下載量分別約2000萬、1800萬與 1400萬。
Muse被定義為「智能體AI助理」，可代表使用者執行多步驟任務，包括瀏覽網頁、發送電子郵件、線上購物、填寫表單以及預訂旅行行程。
Meta自9月16日起加大Muse廣告投放力度，當日下載量季增73%。過去兩週，Muse佔Meta自有廣告展示量的最高50%，臉書與WhatsApp展示份額相應下降。
paras_en: The latest data shows that Meta’s AI assistant Muse, launched about three weeks ago, has surpassed 5 million downloads, topping the free chart on the U.S. App Store and staying at number one for 12 consecutive days.

According to Kara Lee, senior insights analyst at market‑research firm Sensor Tower, Muse crossed the 5 million‑download mark on September 30 (its 22nd day on the market), achieving that scale in a markedly shorter time than ChatGPT (56 days), Grok (103 days) and Claude (492 days).

Sensor Tower data indicate that only 23 apps in the U.S. market have exceeded 5 million downloads within 22 days of launch. About 85 % of them are mobile games such as Fortnite, Pokémon GO and Candy Crush; the non‑gaming category includes just three apps—Disney+, HBO Max and Threads—with roughly 20 million, 18 million and 14 million downloads respectively during the same period.

Muse is defined as an “agent‑type AI assistant” that can act on behalf of users to perform multi‑step tasks, including browsing the web, sending emails, shopping online, filling out forms and booking travel itineraries.

Meta ramped up advertising for Muse starting September 16, driving a 73 % quarter‑over‑quarter increase in downloads on that day. Over the past two weeks, Muse accounted for up to 50 % of Meta’s own ad inventory, while the share of ads shown on Facebook and WhatsApp correspondingly declined.

items.title: Fed總部翻修調查出爐！未發現違法 川普仍逼鮑爾辭理事
items.title_en: Fed Headquarters Renovation Investigation Released! No Illegal Activity Found, Trump Still Presses Powell to Resign as Director
paras: 攸關央行獨立性的美國聯準會(Fed)總部整修案內部調查周三(30日)出爐，Fed監察長認為雖然存在管理與監督缺失，但並未構成違法、也無行政不當，但這卻讓美國總統川普再度把矛頭對準Fed前主席鮑爾(Jerome Powell)，要求他應為Fed總部翻修工程管理不善，辭去Fed理事職務。
川普在社群媒體發文說：「這棟大樓的預算超支，且超支速度創紀錄。至少，『遲到先生』鮑爾應該被迫辭去理事職務。」

未發現犯罪依據 但指管理多項失誤

Fed位於華盛頓國家廣場(National Mall)的兩棟歷史建築翻修工程，目前預估成本約24億美元，較最初預算高出約10億美元。Fed監察長周三公布的內部監察報告指出，該工程在專案監督方面存在問題，但未發現犯罪活動或行政不當行為的證據。
整修案曾是川普政府抨擊鮑爾的焦點，並引發刑事調查與央行獨立性爭議。Fed內部監察報告出爐後，川普要求美國司法部長Todd Blanche審查這份報告，並決定翻修工程的後續措施。
川普隨後再次發文表示：「這是鮑爾的錯，他應該被迫立即辭職！如果他不辭職，就應該由美國政府以貪腐或無能為由，在最高層級對他提起訴訟，這兩者都是完全無法接受的。」
根據監察長的報告，Fed理事會直到2026年1月才從工程管理公司取得專案成本估算，當時距離工程開工已經三年半，而且Fed理事會當時已核准超過20億美元的工程成本。截至2026年7月，也就是工程開工逾四年後，Fed理事會仍未訂定保證最高價格(guaranteed maximum price)。
川普表示，他認為最終工程成本將達35億至40億美元，還說如果工程由他負責，在保留建築原有特色的情況下，只需2500萬美元就能完成翻修工程。
Fed現任主席華許周三表示，Fed將落實報告建議，由美國總務署(GSA)主導後續工程管理，並聘請獨立稽核機構檢查迄今已授予合約的費用。
華許5月接任後，鮑爾仍留任Fed理事，其任期至2028年1月。鮑爾先前表示，在調查真正且徹底結束、具備透明度與明確結論之前，不會離開理事會。

Fed理事受法律保障 川普仍施壓

Potomac River Capital創辦人、Fed相關書籍共同作者Mark Spindel表示，川普雖然沒有威脅要解雇鮑爾，但此次反應凸顯白宮仍持續施壓，希望重新塑造Fed的決策理事會。
Spindel表示：「川普對鮑爾的挫折感沒有上限，他控制Fed的意願也是如此。不過，國會與法院等政治行動者一直支持Fed，面對川普持續不懈的施壓，他們也將繼續支持Fed。」
Fed理事由美國總統提名，並經參議院確認任命。根據《聯準會法》，除非具備「正當理由」，否則總統不得任意解除Fed理事職務。
哥倫比亞大學研究Fed的法學教授Kathryn Judge指出，OIG報告很少提及鮑爾本人在翻修工程監督工作中所扮演的角色，但考量Fed主席肩負的許多其他職責，很難簡單回答主席應該花多少時間監督這類工程。
paras_en: The internal investigation of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) headquarters renovation, a matter tied to the central bank’s independence, was released on Wednesday (the 30th). The Fed’s Office of Inspector General concluded that while there were management and oversight shortcomings, they did not rise to the level of illegality or administrative misconduct. Nevertheless, President Trump again targeted former Fed Chair Jerome Powell, demanding he step down as a Fed director for the mishandling of the renovation project.
Trump posted on social media: “The building’s budget has blown out, and the rate of overspend is record‑setting. At the very least, ‘Mr. Late’ Powell should be forced to resign his director seat.”

No criminal basis found, but multiple management errors identified. The renovation of two historic Fed buildings on Washington’s National Mall is now estimated at about $2.4 billion, roughly $1 billion over the original budget. The OIG’s report released Wednesday noted problems with project supervision but found no evidence of criminal activity or administrative wrongdoing.

The renovation had been a focal point of criticism against Powell by the Trump administration, sparking criminal investigations and debates over central‑bank independence. After the internal report was issued, Trump asked Justice Department Secretary Todd Blanche to review it and decide on further actions regarding the project.

Trump later posted again: “This is Powell’s fault; he should be forced to resign immediately! If he does not step down, the U.S. government should sue him at the highest level for corruption or incompetence—both of which are completely unacceptable.”

According to the OIG report, the Fed Board did not receive a project cost estimate from the management firm until January 2026, three and a half years after construction began, even though the Board had already approved more than $2 billion in project costs. By July 2026—over four years into construction—the Board still had not set a guaranteed maximum price for the work.

Trump claimed the final cost would reach $3.5 billion to $4 billion, and added that if he were in charge, the renovation could be completed for $25 million while preserving the building’s historic character.

Current Fed Chair Lisa Cook said on Wednesday that the Fed will implement the report’s recommendations, with the General Services Administration (GSA) taking charge of subsequent project management and an independent auditor hired to review the contracts awarded to date.

Cook, who took office in May, noted that Powell remains a Fed director, with his term running until January 2028. Powell has previously said he will not leave the Board until the investigation is fully concluded with transparency and clear findings.

Fed directors are protected by law, yet Trump continues to apply pressure. Mark Spindel, founder of Potomac River Capital and co‑author of a book on the Fed, said that while Trump has not threatened to fire Powell, his reaction shows the White House is still pressing to reshape the Fed’s decision‑making board.

Spindel added: “Trump’s frustration with Powell knows no bounds, and his desire to control the Fed is the same. However, Congress, the courts and other political actors have consistently backed the Fed, and they will continue to support it in the face of Trump’s relentless pressure.”
Fed directors are nominated by the President and confirmed by the Senate. Under the Federal Reserve Act, a President may not remove a director without “cause,” i.e., a legitimate reason.

Columbia Law professor Kathryn Judge, who studies the Fed, noted that the OIG report scarcely mentions Powell’s personal role in overseeing the renovation, but given the many other duties of the Fed chair, it is difficult to answer simply how much time the chair should devote to supervising such projects.

items.title: 美光AI需求爆發 Q1財測大幅超預期股價盤後走高
items.title_en: Micron AI Demand Booms; Q1 Outlook Far Beats Expectations, Stock Rises Post‑Market
paras: 美光科技(MU-US)周三(30日)公布2026會計年度第四季財報及2027會計年度第一季財測，受人工智慧(AI)資料中心持續拉動高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及其他記憶體產品需求，公司營收與獲利均優於華爾街預期，並預期下一季業績進一步攀升，帶動股價盤後上漲逾1%。
美光預估2027會計年度第一季營收將達615億美元，上下浮動15億美元，明顯高於分析師平均預估的567.7億美元；調整後每股盈餘(EPS)預估為38.15美元，上下浮動1美元，也高於市場預期的36.02美元。公司預估第一季調整後毛利率約86.25%，調整後營業費用約20.6億美元。
強勁財測反映AI基礎建設需求仍在快速成長。美光表示，伺服器用LPDDR SOCAMM產品第四季營收較前一季增加逾1倍，PCIe Gen 5及Gen 6固態硬碟(SSD)產品也已出貨給客戶，用於AI相關快取應用。公司執行長梅羅特拉(Sanjay Mehrotra)表示，美光2026會計年度創下創紀錄表現，預期2027會計年度將更加強勁，主要受到AI需求及策略性客戶協議支持。
美光第四季營收達542.3億美元，較去年同期大增379%，高於市場預估的504.5億至510.7億美元；調整後每股盈餘為33.42美元，高於分析師預估的31.16至31.72美元。調整後毛利率由第三季的84.9%升至87.0%，調整後營業利益由前一季的336.8億美元增加至446.4億美元，調整後淨利則由288.6億美元升至384.0億美元。
以GAAP口徑計算，美光第四季營收為542.29億美元，淨利為377.01億美元；營運現金流達439.73億美元。如此大幅成長，使公司2026會計年度全年營運表現達到新高，也顯示AI資料中心對記憶體及儲存產品的需求已經成為推動美光業績的重要力量。
AI伺服器需要大量HBM及高速記憶體，以配合AI加速器處理龐大的資料傳輸需求。美光目前是美國主要的HBM製造商，也是輝達(NVDA-US)的重要供應商之一。隨著生成式AI及AI代理等應用持續擴大，雲端服務商及大型科技企業持續提高資料中心投資，進一步推升HBM及伺服器記憶體需求。
美光表示，目前HBM訂單需求已大幅超過公司現有產能，AI記憶體需求強勁也使傳統記憶體供應趨緊，推升整體半導體市場的價格。公司因此持續擴大產能及技術投資，已將截至2035年的美國投資計畫提高至超過2500億美元。
AI基礎建設支出規模也持續擴大。Reuters指出，Amazon(AMZN-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)及其他大型科技企業今年在AI基礎建設上的支出預計超過7300億美元，記憶體供應商因此受惠於資料中心擴建所帶動的需求成長。
美光也正透過多年期策略性客戶協議，提高未來營收的可預測性。截至最新財報，公司已簽署36份多年期供應協議，高於上一季的16份，這些協議涵蓋約三分之一的營收，並延伸至2030年。部分合約採取長達5年的供應安排，包含價格下限、較高價格上限、具約束力的採購承諾及客戶預付款等條款。
這類協議是美光降低記憶體產業週期性波動的重要措施。記憶體市場過去經常受到供需變化影響，價格及獲利容易大幅波動；美光透過較長期的供應合約鎖定部分需求，希望讓AI時代的高需求能轉化為更穩定的長期營收及現金流。
強勁的業績也大幅改善美光的現金流狀況。公司2026會計年度自由現金流達590億美元，期間償還約100億美元債務，剩餘債務降至約50億美元，同時已啟動股票回購計畫。市場預期公司2027會計年度自由現金流可能進一步達到約1290億美元。
產品方面，美光此前已開始量產出貨採用1-beta DRAM技術的HBM4，並向多家終端客戶提供產品認證樣品；下一代採用1-gamma DRAM技術的HBM4E正在開發，預計2027年進入量產。公司也已向伺服器生態系統主要客戶提供256GB DDR5 RDIMM認證樣品，顯示AI伺服器及高階資料中心記憶體產品布局持續擴大。
美光股價今年以來已大幅上漲，Reuters指出，截至周三盤後公布財報前，公司股價今年累計漲幅已超過3倍；財報及財測公布後，盤後交易一度上漲逾1%。
市場目前關注的焦點已從AI需求能否延續，轉向美光能否透過擴產、HBM升級及多年期客戶合約滿足快速增加的訂單。公司管理層表示，記憶體及儲存市場的供需狀況預計在2027及2028會計年度將比2026會計年度更加緊俏，意味著AI資料中心擴張仍可能為記憶體產業帶來持續需求。
整體而言，美光最新財報顯示AI需求正同時推動HBM、伺服器DRAM及AI儲存產品成長，而第一季財測大幅高於市場預期，進一步反映公司對AI記憶體景氣延續的信心。不過，隨著公司積極擴大美國及全球產能，後續供應增加速度、資本支出規模及AI資料中心需求是否能維持目前成長速度，仍將是市場評估美光後續業績的重要因素。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU‑US) on Wednesday (the 30th) released its fourth‑quarter fiscal 2026 results and first‑quarter fiscal 2027 outlook. Continued AI data‑center demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and other memory products lifted both revenue and profit beyond Wall Street forecasts, and the company expects next‑quarter performance to climb further, sending the share price up more than 1% in after‑hours trading.

Micron projects first‑quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $61.5 billion, give or take $1.5 billion, well above analysts’ average estimate of $56.77 billion. Adjusted earnings per share are forecast at $38.15, plus or minus $1.00, also topping the market view of $36.02. The company expects an adjusted gross margin of roughly 86.25% for the quarter and adjusted operating expenses of about $2.06 billion.

The strong outlook reflects the rapid growth of AI infrastructure demand. Micron said server‑grade LPDDR SOCAMM sales more than doubled in Q4 versus the prior quarter, and PCIe Gen 5 and Gen 6 SSDs have already shipped to customers for AI‑related caching workloads. CEO Sanjay Mehrotra noted that fiscal 2026 was a record‑setting year and that fiscal 2027 should be even stronger, driven primarily by AI demand and strategic customer agreements.

Micron’s Q4 revenue reached $54.23 billion, up 379% year‑over‑year and above the market range of $50.45 billion to $51.07 billion. Adjusted EPS was $33.42, beating analyst forecasts of $31.16‑$31.72. Adjusted gross margin rose from 84.9% in Q3 to 87.0%, adjusted operating profit climbed from $33.68 billion to $44.64 billion, and adjusted net income increased from $28.86 billion to $38.40 billion.

On a GAAP basis, Micron’s Q4 revenue was $54.229 billion with GAAP net income of $37.701 billion and operating cash flow of $43.973 billion. Such dramatic growth pushed full‑year fiscal 2026 operating performance to a new high and underscored that AI data‑center demand for memory and storage is now a key engine of Micron’s results.

AI servers require large amounts of HBM and high‑speed memory to feed AI accelerators’ massive data‑transfer needs. Micron is currently the United States’ leading HBM maker and a key supplier to Nvidia (NVDA‑US). As generative AI, AI agents and related workloads expand, cloud providers and large tech firms are boosting data‑center investment, further lifting demand for HBM and server memory.

Micron said HBM order demand now far exceeds its existing capacity, and the surge in AI memory demand is tightening supply of traditional memory, pushing up overall semiconductor prices. The company is therefore expanding capacity and technology spend, raising its U.S. investment plan through 2035 to over $250 billion.

AI infrastructure spending continues to grow. Reuters estimates that Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and other big tech firms will spend more than $730 billion on AI infrastructure this year, benefitting memory suppliers through the data‑center expansion‑driven demand surge.

Micron is also increasing revenue predictability through multi‑year strategic customer agreements. As of the latest filing, Micron has signed 36 multi‑year supply contracts, up from 16 in the prior quarter, covering roughly one‑third of its revenue and extending through 2030. Some deals lock in up to five‑year supply terms with price floors, higher price caps, binding purchase commitments and customer pre‑payments.

These long‑term contracts are a key tool for Micron to blunt the cyclical swings of the memory industry. Historically, memory prices and profits have been highly volatile with supply‑demand shifts; by locking in demand via longer‑term agreements, Micron hopes to turn AI‑driven high demand into steadier, long‑term revenue and cash flow.

The strong results also markedly improved Micron’s cash‑flow position. Free cash flow for fiscal 2026 reached $59 billion, the company repaid about $10 billion of debt, reducing total debt to roughly $5 billion, and launched a share‑repurchase program. The market expects fiscal 2027 free cash flow could climb to about $129 billion.

On the product side, Micron has already begun volume production and shipment of HBM4 using 1‑beta DRAM technology and has supplied qualification samples to several end customers. The next‑generation HBM4E, built on 1‑gamma DRAM, is under development and slated for volume production in 2027. Micron has also provided 256 GB DDR5 RDIMM qualification samples to major server ecosystem customers, showing the continued expansion of its AI‑server and high‑end data‑center memory portfolio.

Micron’s stock has surged dramatically this year. Reuters noted that before the after‑hours release of the earnings, the share price had already risen more than three‑fold year‑to‑date; after the results and outlook were disclosed, after‑hours trading briefly pushed the price up over 1%.

Market focus has shifted from whether AI demand can be sustained to whether Micron can meet the rapidly growing order flow through capacity expansion, HBM upgrades and multi‑year customer contracts. Management says supply‑demand conditions in memory and storage are expected to be tighter in fiscal 2027 and 2028 than in fiscal 2026, implying AI data‑center expansion will likely keep driving strong demand for the memory industry.

Overall, Micron’s latest results show AI demand is simultaneously driving growth in HBM, server DRAM and AI storage products, and the Q1 outlook far exceeds market expectations, reflecting confidence in continued AI‑memory tailwinds. However, as Micron aggressively expands U.S. and global capacity, the pace of supply additions, the scale of capex and the durability of AI data‑center demand will remain key factors for the market in assessing Micron’s future performance.

items.title: 美光AI記憶體需求續強長約續增至320億美元、FY2027供需更吃緊
items.title_en: Micron AI Memory Demand Remains Strong, Long-Term Contracts Rise to $32 B, Supply Tightens Through FY2027
paras: 2026年10月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美光Micron Technology(MU-US)公布最新財報與展望，受AI資料中心帶動高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及儲存需求持續升溫，公司預估下一季營收將高於市場預期，同時透露客戶長期供應協議的財務承諾已由6月公布的220億美元提高至320億美元，且多數以現金預付款形式支付，顯示客戶為確保記憶體供應，提前鎖定產能的意願持續升高。
美光執行長Sanjay Mehrotra表示，相較2026會計年度，公司預期2027及2028會計年度記憶體與儲存市場供需將更加吃緊。美光總裁暨營運長Manish Bhatia也指出，目前AI基礎建設面臨的主要限制之一就是記憶體供給，資料中心已成為全球最大的記憶體與儲存應用市場。
AI伺服器對HBM需求快速增加，是本波記憶體景氣的重要推力。美光為輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)主要記憶體供應商之一，公司表示，目前訂單需求已明顯超過既有產能，並已簽訂大部分2027年HBM產能的供應協議。
除了長約金額增加，美光尚未履行的合約義務(Remaining Performance Obligations, RPO)也由上一季約1,000億美元提高至約1,500億美元，反映已簽約但尚未認列的未來營收規模持續擴大。
財務長Mark Murphy表示，美光預期2027會計年度將再創紀錄，且各季營收可望逐季成長。公司預估2027會計年度第1季營收為615億美元，上下浮動15億美元，高於LSEG彙整分析師平均預估的570.2億美元；調整後每股盈餘預估38.15美元，上下浮動1美元，也高於市場預估35.40美元。
美光2026會計年度第4季營收年增超過3倍至542.3億美元，高於市場預估510.7億美元；調整後每股盈餘33.42美元，同樣優於市場預估31.61美元。
供給端仍是後續觀察重點。由於訂單大幅超過產能，美光7月已將2035年前美國投資規模提高至超過2,500億美元，同時正在全球多數生產基地擴充產能，並於美國及日本興建新廠。
Bhatia表示，新廠預計2027年中開始產出首批矽晶圓，但從開始生產到產能對市場形成明顯貢獻，仍需數季爬坡時間。這意味短期內新增供給難以快速追上AI需求。
Mehrotra也表示，美光已簽訂大部分2027年HBM產能，並將把2027會計年度資本支出提高至原先規畫以上，以增加產能。
全球大型雲端服務商持續擴大AI投資，也是記憶體需求維持高檔的重要背景。包括亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)等科技業者，今年AI基礎建設資本支出合計預計超過7,300億美元，伺服器GPU數量增加，也同步拉升HBM、DRAM與企業級儲存需求。
美光目前主要與三星電子Samsung Electronics(005930-KR)及SK海力士SK Hynix(000660-KR)競爭HBM市場。隨AI伺服器記憶體用量持續提升，加上先進製程擴產時間較長，市場關注焦點已從單純需求成長，進一步轉向2027至2028年HBM及高階DRAM產能能否跟上客戶訂單。

paras_en: On October 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Micron Technology (MU‑US) released its latest earnings and outlook. Driven by AI data centers, demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and storage continues to heat up. The company expects next‑quarter revenue to beat market forecasts and disclosed that the financial commitment in its long‑term supply agreements has been raised from $22 billion announced in June to $32 billion, most of which will be paid as cash pre‑payments, indicating customers’ growing willingness to lock in capacity early to secure memory supply.

CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said that, compared with fiscal 2026, Micron expects the memory and storage market to become even tighter in fiscal 2027 and 2028. President and COO Manish Bhatia also noted that one of the main constraints facing AI infrastructure today is memory supply, and data centers have become the world’s largest market for memory and storage applications.

AI servers’ rapid increase in HBM demand is a key driver of the current memory boom. Micron, a major memory supplier to NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), said that order demand now clearly exceeds existing capacity and that it has signed most of the supply agreements for HBM capacity in 2027.

In addition to the larger long‑term contract amount, Micron’s Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) that have not yet been fulfilled rose from roughly $100 billion in the prior quarter to about $150 billion, reflecting a growing scale of contracted but not yet recognized future revenue.

CFO Mark Murphy said Micron expects fiscal 2027 to set a new record, with quarterly revenue growing sequentially. The company forecasts FY2027 Q1 revenue at $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion, above LSEG analysts’ average estimate of $57.02 billion; adjusted earnings per share are projected at $38.15, plus or minus $1.00, also above the market estimate of $35.40.

Micron’s FY2026 Q4 revenue grew more than three‑fold year‑over‑year to $54.23 billion, beating the market estimate of $51.07 billion; adjusted EPS was $33.42, again ahead of the market’s $31.61 expectation.

Supply remains a key focus going forward. Because orders far exceed capacity, Micron raised its U.S. investment plan through 2035 in July to over $250 billion and is expanding capacity at most of its global fabs while building new plants in the United States and Japan.

Bhatia said the new plants are expected to start producing their first silicon wafers in mid‑2027, but it will take several quarters of ramp‑up before the capacity makes a noticeable market contribution. This means short‑term new supply will struggle to keep pace with AI demand.
Mehrotra added that Micron has signed most of the 2027 HBM capacity and will increase FY2027 capital expenditures beyond the original plan to boost capacity.

Major global cloud providers continue to expand AI investments, underpinning strong memory demand. Companies such as Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) are expected to spend over $730 billion this year on AI infrastructure, and the rise in server GPUs is simultaneously driving up demand for HBM, DRAM and enterprise‑grade storage.

Micron currently competes mainly with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR) and SK Hynix (000660‑KR) in the HBM market. As AI server memory usage keeps rising and advanced‑process expansion takes time, market attention is shifting from pure demand growth to whether HBM and high‑end DRAM capacity can keep up with customer orders in 2027‑2028.

items.title: 普丁：俄羅斯與一些國家不同 不會滿世界「乞討」
items.title_en: Putin: Russia, unlike some countries, will not beg around the world
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁30日（周四）在國家杜馬（議會下院）會議上發表講話，據《塔斯社》報導，普丁在講話中說，與一些國家不同，俄羅斯不會滿世界「乞討」。
普丁說：「與一些國家不同——就不點名了，俄羅斯不會跑到世界各地卑躬屈膝乞求施捨。首先，正如我剛才所說，這樣做非常恥辱。其次，沒有人會給我國，我國很清楚這一點。最後，也是最重要的一點，我國不需要這樣做。」
普丁強調，任何人都無法摧毀或恐嚇俄羅斯人民，俄羅斯有能力在未來幾代人中繼續確保國家安全和主權。
俄羅斯已於本月舉行國家杜馬選舉，這是2022年俄烏衝突全面升級以來首次國家杜馬選舉。統一俄羅斯黨贏得349席，俄羅斯聯邦共產黨獲37席，自由民主黨23席，新人黨19席，公正俄羅斯黨17席，祖國黨1席，4名自薦候選人各獲1席。
在當地時間30日召開的俄羅斯第九屆國家杜馬第一次全體會議上，統一俄羅斯黨推舉的國家杜馬主席候選人沃洛金再次當選國家杜馬主席。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke at a State Duma (lower house) meeting on Thursday, the 30th, and, according to TASS, said that unlike some countries, Russia will not go around the world “begging.”

Putin said: “Unlike some countries – I won’t name them – Russia will not crawl around the world, groveling and begging for charity. First, as I just mentioned, that would be deeply humiliating. Second, no one is going to give to our country, and we are well aware of that. Finally, and most importantly, our country does not need to do that.”
Putin emphasized that no one can destroy or intimidate the Russian people, and that Russia has the capability to continue ensuring national security and sovereignty for generations to come.

Russia held a State Duma election earlier this month, the first since the full‑scale escalation of the Russia‑Ukraine conflict in 2022. United Russia won 349 seats, the Communist Party of the Russian Federation secured 37 seats, the Liberal Democratic Party took 23 seats, New People obtained 19 seats, A Just Russia got 17 seats, the Patriots of Russia won 1 seat, and four self‑nominated candidates each received one seat.
At the first plenary session of the 9th State Duma held on the 30th local time, Volodin, the United Russia‑nominated candidate, was re‑elected as Chairman of the State Duma.

items.title: 川普10萬美元H-1B費用連遭兩法官阻擋 科技業招才再陷法律戰
items.title_en: Trump's $100,000 H‑1B Fee Blocked by Two Judges, Tech Hiring Faces New Legal Battles
paras: 美國總統川普針對新H-1B工作簽證加徵10萬美元費用的政策再遭法院阻擋。加州奧克蘭聯邦地區法院法官Haywood Gilliam週三(30日)裁定, 美國公民及移民服務局(USCIS)與國務院在執行這項費用前未遵循必要的規則制定程序, 因此禁止相關政府機構繼續執行這項收費措施。這也是第二名聯邦法官出手阻擋10萬美元H-1B費用。
Gilliam受理的是工會、企業及非營利組織組成的聯盟所提訴訟。該聯盟去年10月提告, 要求阻止川普政府實施這項費用。法院此次裁定暫停相關機構執行川普的10萬美元收費要求, 直至訴訟程序進一步發展。
這項判決與6月波士頓聯邦法院的裁決形成呼應。波士頓聯邦法官當時在20州提起的另一宗案件中, 認定川普政府設定10萬美元H-1B費用的做法違法並阻止政府收取; 第一巡迴上訴法院7月也拒絕暫停該判決, 代表政府在上訴期間無法恢復這項費用。
目前美國商會也另外提起訴訟挑戰10萬美元費用。該組織是美國規模最大的商業遊說團體, 此案則涉及另一名法官此前駁回商會主張後的上訴程序。換言之, 川普政府目前面對至少3條與10萬美元H-1B費用相關的法律戰線。
川普政府最初是在2025年9月宣布10萬美元費用, 對象主要是新的H-1B簽證申請, 並透過總統公告限制部分目前人在美國境外的申請人入境。政府主張, 總統依據聯邦移民法具有限制特定外國人入境的權力, 因此可以要求支付這項費用。川普及政府官員則表示, H-1B制度遭到部分企業濫用, 包括以較低薪資的外籍勞工取代美國勞工。
H-1B制度是美國企業聘用具專業技能外籍人才的重要管道, 每年一般配額為6.5萬個名額, 另有2萬個名額提供擁有美國高等學位的申請人, 簽證通常可核准3年並延長至6年。川普政府此次政策大幅提高企業成本, 在此之前H-1B相關費用通常約為2000至5000美元, 實際金額視申請類型等因素而定。
科技產業是H-1B制度的主要使用者之一。包括Amazon (AMZN-US)、Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、Microsoft (MSFT-US)、Apple (AAPL-US)及Meta Platforms (META-US)等大型科技企業, 長期透過H-1B制度招聘工程、軟體、人工智慧及其他專業人才。近期科技產業團體也進一步反對政府提出的新一輪H-1B費用調升方案。
值得注意的是, 川普政府8月提出另一項金額為10萬3265美元的H-1B費用規則, 試圖透過正式行政規則制定程序, 將新的高額費用制度化。這項方案與目前遭法院阻擋的10萬美元總統公告費用屬於不同法律程序, 因此即使法院阻止原有10萬美元費用, 10萬3265美元的新規仍可能繼續推進, 但同樣可能面臨新的法律挑戰。
美國國土安全部(DHS)8月公布的提案顯示, 新費用設定為10萬3265美元, 目標是透過正式規則制定程序建立新的H-1B收費制度。與最初的總統公告不同, 這項方案經過公告及徵詢意見等行政程序, 因此政府希望以不同法律途徑建立長期制度。相關規則若最終定案, 仍可能遭企業及產業團體提告。
科技產業對10萬3265美元方案的反對也在近期升高。代表大型科技及人工智慧企業的TechNet在9月提交正式意見, 要求政府撤回這項費用。該組織表示, 高額費用可能限制美國企業取得全球專業人才的能力, 並可能影響美國在人工智慧領域的競爭力。TechNet成員包括多家大型網路及AI企業, 也包括輝達(NVDA-US)。
除了科技巨頭之外, 產業團體也指出, 高額固定費用對不同類型雇主的影響並不相同。H-1B大量使用者包括科技企業、顧問公司、外包服務商及研究機構, 而企業聘用外籍專業人才的成本將取決於實際申請數量及職缺需求。Reuters此前報導, H-1B計畫2025年雇主登記約34.4萬件, 比2024年下降逾25%, 也不到2023年75.9萬件的一半。
另一方面, H-1B政策變化已開始影響企業人才布局。Reuters此前報導, Google等主要H-1B使用企業在簽證審查與處理方式改變後, 已增加在印度等海外地區的業務布局。科技企業則表示, H-1B制度能協助企業招聘美國國內難以找到的專業人才。
H-1B申請量也受到政策變化影響。美國移民局資料顯示, 雇主在前一年度登記約34.4萬件H-1B申請, 較2024年的數字下降超過四分之一; 2023年申請量則曾達75.9萬件。至於最初10萬美元費用的實際支付情況, 法院文件顯示截至2026年2月底, 約70家雇主合計僅支付85件相關簽證申請的10萬美元費用。
川普政府同時持續推動H-1B制度其他改革, 包括加強申請人審查, 並提出新的簽證選擇方式, 讓較高技能及較高薪資的申請人獲得較有利的排序。政府也曾提出進一步調整制度的方案, 使H-1B政策不只涉及費用, 還涵蓋申請審查及名額分配方式。
對企業而言, 當前最大的問題在於10萬美元費用的法律地位仍未完全確定。雖然兩名聯邦法官已先後阻止政府執行原有費用, 且上訴法院此前拒絕讓政府在上訴期間恢復收費, 但美國商會的案件以及政府相關上訴仍在進行中。與此同時, 政府提出的10萬3265美元新規則又開啟另一條法律與行政程序, 因此H-1B費用問題短期內仍可能持續成為美國科技業及企業招聘政策的重要爭議。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump’s policy of imposing a $100,000 fee on new H‑1B work visas was again halted by the courts. On Wednesday (the 30th), U.S. District Judge Haywood Gilliam in the Oakland, California federal court ruled that the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) and the State Department failed to follow required rulemaking procedures before implementing the fee, and therefore barred the agencies from enforcing the charge. This marks the second federal judge to block the $100,000 H‑1B fee.

Judge Gilliam was hearing a lawsuit brought by a coalition of labor unions, businesses and nonprofit groups. The coalition filed the suit in October last year seeking to stop the Trump administration’s fee. The court’s order pauses the agencies’ enforcement of the $100,000 charge until the litigation progresses further.

The decision echoes a June ruling by a federal court in Boston. At that time a Boston judge, hearing a separate case filed in 20 states, found the administration’s $100,000 H‑1B fee unlawful and stopped the government from collecting it; the First Circuit Court of Appeals in July also refused to stay that ruling, meaning the fee could not be reinstated during the appeal.

The U.S. Chamber of Commerce has also filed a separate lawsuit challenging the $100,000 fee. The Chamber, the nation’s largest business‑lobbying group, is pursuing a case that involves a different judge who had previously dismissed the Chamber’s claim and is now hearing the appeal. In short, the Trump administration is confronting at least three separate legal fronts over the $100,000 H‑1B fee.

The Trump administration first announced the $100,000 fee in September 2025, targeting new H‑1B applications and, via a presidential proclamation, restricting entry for some applicants currently abroad. The administration argued that the president has authority under federal immigration law to limit entry of certain foreign nationals and therefore can require the fee. Trump and his officials said the H‑1B program is being abused by some firms that replace U.S. workers with lower‑paid foreign labor.

The H‑1B program is a key channel for U.S. companies to hire foreign professionals with specialized skills. The annual cap is generally 65,000 visas, plus an additional 20,000 for applicants with U.S. advanced degrees. Visas are typically approved for three years and can be extended to six. The Trump‑era policy would dramatically raise employer costs; previously H‑1B‑related fees ranged from about $2,000 to $5,000, depending on the type of petition.

The tech sector is one of the biggest users of the H‑1B program. Large technology firms such as Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Meta Platforms (META‑US) have long relied on H‑1B visas to recruit engineers, software developers, AI specialists and other professionals. Recent industry groups have also stepped up opposition to the administration’s new fee‑increase proposal.

It is noteworthy that in August the Trump administration proposed a separate $100,326.5 fee rule, attempting to codify the higher charge through the formal rulemaking process. This proposal follows a different legal pathway from the $100,000 fee announced by presidential proclamation, so even if courts block the original fee, the $100,326.5 rule could still move forward, though it may face fresh legal challenges.

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) released a proposal in August setting the new fee at $100,326.5, aiming to establish a permanent H‑1B fee structure via the formal rulemaking process. Unlike the initial proclamation, this proposal has gone through notice‑and‑comment procedures, and the administration hopes to create a lasting regime through a different legal route. If finalized, the rule could still be sued by companies and industry groups.

Opposition from the tech sector to the $100,326.5 proposal has intensified recently. TechNet, which represents large tech and AI firms, submitted formal comments in September urging the administration to withdraw the fee. The group warned that the steep charge could limit U.S. companies’ ability to attract global talent and hurt America’s competitiveness in artificial intelligence. TechNet’s members include several major internet and AI companies, as well as Nvidia (NVDA‑US).

Beyond the big tech players, industry groups note that a flat high fee does not affect all employers equally. Heavy H‑1B users include tech firms, consulting firms, outsourcing providers and research institutions, and the cost to hire foreign specialists will depend on the number of petitions and job‑level needs. Reuters previously reported that employer registrations for H‑1B in 2025 are projected at about 344,000, down more than 25% from 2024 and less than half of the 759,000 filings in 2023.

Changes to the H‑1B policy are already influencing corporate talent strategies. Reuters earlier reported that major H‑1B‑using companies such as Google have shifted visa review and processing practices and have expanded operations in overseas locations like India. Tech firms say the H‑1B program remains essential for hiring specialized talent that is scarce in the U.S. labor market.

Application volumes have also been affected by the policy shifts. USCIS data show that employers filed roughly 344,000 H‑1B petitions in the most recent fiscal year, a drop of more than a quarter from 2024’s figure; the 2023 filing count peaked at 759,000. Regarding actual payments of the original $100,000 fee, court filings indicate that by the end of February 2026 about 70 employers had paid the fee for only 85 visa petitions.

The Trump administration continues to push other H‑1B reforms, including tighter applicant vetting and a new visa selection system that gives higher‑skill, higher‑salary candidates more favorable ranking. The administration has also floated broader adjustments to the program, so that reforms go beyond fees to cover adjudication standards and allocation of the annual cap.

For companies, the biggest uncertainty remains the legal status of the $100,000 fee. Although two federal judges have already blocked the government’s ability to collect the original charge and the appellate court previously refused to let the fee be reinstated during the appeal, the Chamber of Commerce case and other government appeals are still pending. At the same time, the administration’s $100,326.5 rule opens a separate legal and administrative track, meaning the H‑1B fee issue is likely to stay a hot‑button dispute for the tech industry and corporate hiring policies in the near term.

items.title: AI支出續強勁 美銀點名美光、輝達、英特爾等「贏家」
items.title_en: AI Spending Remains Strong, BofA Names Micron, Nvidia, Intel and Others as Winners
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，今年只剩下3個月，對華爾街而言，這意味著市場開始展望明年的經濟、股市與各產業表現。分析師提出的重要觀點帶動相關股票走勢並不罕見，尤其當這些看法同時伴隨目標價與獲利預估上調時，更容易對股價產生影響。
以下是近期第一批值得關注的前瞻性市場觀點之一，來自美國銀行半導體分析師Vivek Arya，聚焦於AI熱潮核心企業的動能型科技股。
Arya指出，AI資本支出有很大機會高於許多市場預期，並成為多檔股票超乎預期的順風力量。
談到AI基礎設施前景，Arya表示，「我們將2026年至2030年AI資料中心系統的整體潛在市場(TAM)預估，從原先的1.8兆美元、年增33%，上調至2.2兆美元，年增達40%。」
「消費者與企業採用AI代理工具形成的良性循環、公有與私有AI實驗室之間的競爭，以及晶片供應有限，都可能讓未來幾年的AI支出保持強勁。」
他表示，先進AI模型若放慢開發進度或增加安全防護措施，可能反而增加而非降低運算需求，並讓更多需求從訓練轉向成長速度更快的推理運算。
同時，頂尖晶片股的估值相較每股盈餘(EPS)成長預估仍具吸引力。費城半導體指數目前的預估本益比為21倍，比ChatGPT問世以來24倍的中位數本益比低12%，而EPS成長潛力預估則超過40%。

看好的晶片股贏家

在Arya修正後的AI投資論點下，多檔股票都具備看多條件。
Arya寫道，「從歷史來看，第四曆季(CQ4)與第一曆季(CQ1)是持有晶片股表現最好的兩個季。2010年至2025年期間，晶片股相較標普500指數的中位數超額報酬為300至500個基點。」
他指出目前最看好個股，以及近期催化因素包括：

輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)：加大股票回購，以及多場GTC科技大會活動。
英特爾(Intel)(INTC-US)：AI代理帶動CPU需求，以及市場期待其晶圓代工業務取得新訂單。
美光(Micron)(MU-US)：預計12月9日起啟動股票回購。
邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)：10月6日舉行分析師日，以及XPU出貨量提升。
科林研發(Lam Research)(LRCX-US)：有望在記憶體與邏輯晶片領域提高市占率。


此外，美銀也持續看好AMD(AMD-US)、應用材料(Applied Materials)(AMAT-US)、亞德諾半導體(Analog Devices)(ADI-US)與安森美(On Semiconductor)(ON-US)。
同時持續關注博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)。美銀目前給予該股買進評級，主要是看好博通具吸引力的估值。並指出，博通「12月公布第四財季業績時，也可能宣布加大股票回購。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that with only three months left in the year, Wall Street is beginning to look ahead to next year’s economy, stock market and sector performance. It is not uncommon for analysts’ key viewpoints to drive related stock moves, especially when those views are accompanied by target‑price and earnings‑forecast upgrades, which can more easily affect share prices.

One of the first forward‑looking market viewpoints to watch recently comes from Bank of America semiconductor analyst Vivek Arya, who focuses on momentum‑driven tech stocks at the core of the AI boom.
Arya said AI capital spending has a high chance of exceeding many market expectations and will become a tailwind that pushes several stocks beyond forecasts.

Discussing the outlook for AI infrastructure, Arya stated, “We have revised our estimate of the total addressable market (TAM) for AI data‑center systems from 2026 to 2030, raising it from the original $1.8 trillion with a 33% annual growth rate to $2.2 trillion with a 40% annual growth rate.”

He added that a virtuous cycle of consumer and enterprise adoption of AI agents, competition between public and private AI labs, and limited chip supply could keep AI spending robust for the coming years.

He noted that if the development of advanced AI models slows or more safety safeguards are added, compute demand could actually increase rather than decrease, shifting more demand from training to faster‑growing inference workloads.

At the same time, valuations for top chip stocks remain attractive relative to projected earnings‑per‑share (EPS) growth. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index currently trades at a forward P/E of 21×, about 12% below the post‑ChatGPT median of 24×, while EPS growth potential is estimated at over 40%.
Chip‑stock winners under Arya’s revised AI investment thesis have multiple stocks with bullish upside.

Arya wrote, “Historically, the fourth calendar quarter (CQ4) and the first calendar quarter (CQ1) have been the two best quarters for holding chip stocks. From 2010 to 2025, chip stocks have delivered median excess returns of 300 to 500 basis points over the S&P 500.”
He highlighted the individual stocks he is most bullish on, along with near‑term catalysts:

Nvidia (NVDA‑US): larger share‑repurchase program and multiple GTC technology‑conference events. Intel (INTC‑US): AI agents driving CPU demand and market expectations of new wafer‑fab orders. Micron (MU‑US): planned share‑repurchase program starting Dec 9. Marvell (MRVL‑US): analyst day on Oct 6 and rising XPU shipments. Lam Research (LRCX‑US): potential market‑share gains in memory and logic chips.

In addition, BofA continues to favor AMD (AMD‑US), Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Analog Devices (ADI‑US) and ON Semiconductor (ON‑US). It also remains watchful of Broadcom (AVGO‑US), which BofA rates as a buy due to its attractive valuation and notes that Broadcom may announce an expanded share‑repurchase program when it reports fourth‑quarter results in December.

items.title: AI資料中心搶電！Bloom Energy今年暴漲219% 克雷默仍看好但喊「先別追」
items.title_en: AI Data Centers Scramble for Power! Bloom Energy Soars 219% This Year, Cramer Still Bullish but Says “Don’t Chase Yet”
paras: CNBC知名財經節目主持人克雷默(Jim Cramer)週三表示，在AI資料中心建設帶動的「表後供電」(behind-the-meter)市場中，Bloom Energy (BE-US)仍是他最看好的投資方式，但目前並不是他願意立即進場追價的時點。克雷默認為，若投資人希望掌握AI基礎建設背後快速增加的電力需求，Bloom Energy仍是他的首選標的之一，長期而言股價未來幾年仍可能進一步走高。
Bloom Energy今年股價已大漲219%，其中9月單月上漲34%，主要受到AI資料中心建設加速及現場燃料電池需求升溫帶動。該股自克雷默今年2月介紹這家公司以來，股價幾乎已翻倍。
Bloom Energy的核心技術是模組化固態氧化物燃料電池系統，可部署在資料中心等大型用電設施附近，直接提供主要或備援電力，不必完全依賴公共電網。系統可將燃料轉換為電力而不透過傳統燃燒方式發電，因此能以模組化方式擴充，成為AI資料中心在等待電網接入期間的替代供電方案。
AI資料中心目前面臨的核心限制之一就是電力。資料中心的規模通常以需要多少GW的持續電力來衡量，隨著AI運算需求增加，電力供應已成為決定資料中心能否擴建的重要因素。Bloom Energy的現場供電系統則主打縮短取得電力所需的時間，避免業者必須等待數年才能完成新的電網連接。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)就是其中一個案例。Bloom Energy表示，公司曾在55天內完成向甲骨文一座資料中心供電的部署，遠低於傳統大型電力基礎建設可能需要的時間。兩家公司今年4月也進一步擴大合作，甲骨文旗下AI及雲端基礎建設計畫將採購最多2.8GW的Bloom燃料電池系統，其中初始1.2GW容量已簽約並開始部署。
Bloom Energy的財務表現也反映AI資料中心需求的快速成長。公司第2季營收達約10.7億美元，年增166%，明顯超越市場預期；調整後每股盈餘為0.78美元，幾乎是市場原先預期的兩倍。公司並上調2026年全年營收預測至39億至42億美元，中間值約40.5億美元，意味著全年營收規模可望較前一年翻倍。
Bloom Energy在2025年全年營收已達20.2億美元，較2024年的14.7億美元增加37.3%，公司當時表示，AI資料中心產業的需求是推動營收創新高的重要因素。
Bloom Energy表示，包括大型超大規模雲端服務商、超過12家neocloud業者及AI實驗室在內的客戶，都已對其技術表示支持或完成驗證，顯示現場供電市場正從早期測試階段逐步進入商業部署。
Bloom Energy近期也持續強化AI電力布局。公司9月推出Power Connect技術，主打將現場電力安裝時間縮短超過40%；此外，公司持續推動800V DC-native電力架構，針對AI資料中心高密度運算所需的電力環境，降低傳統交流電轉換過程可能造成的損耗及設備需求。
Bloom Energy同時面臨來自其他表後發電技術的競爭，包括GE Vernova (GEV-US)的大型燃氣渦輪機。與Bloom Energy的模組化燃料電池不同，GE Vernova主要透過大型燃氣渦輪機提供電力，兩家公司都試圖搶攻AI資料中心快速增加的現場供電需求。
隨著AI資料中心建設規模不斷擴大，電力供應的重要性也從AI產業的周邊議題逐漸轉變為核心基礎建設。Bloom Energy今年大幅增加的營收、甲骨文的大型訂單，以及其他AI業者的採用，均使市場更加關注現場發電能否成為傳統電網之外的重要供電來源。
不過，克雷默也提醒投資人不要因看好AI電力需求就追高Bloom Energy。按照當時市場預期，Bloom Energy股價約相當於今年預估每股盈餘的108倍，以及明年預估每股盈餘的59倍，估值已反映相當高的成長預期。
因此，克雷默雖然仍將Bloom Energy視為AI電力需求的首選投資方式，但他的看法並非建議投資人立即買進，而是等待股價回檔後再評估長期布局機會。Bloom Energy預計10月27日公布第3季財報，屆時營收、訂單及AI資料中心相關業務進展，將成為市場觀察公司成長能否延續的重要指標。
paras_en: CNBC’s well‑known finance show host Jim Cramer said on Wednesday that in the behind‑the‑meter market driven by AI data‑center construction, Bloom Energy (BE‑US) remains his top investment pick, but it’s not a time he’s willing to jump in and buy at current prices. Cramer believes that investors looking to capture the rapidly growing electricity demand behind AI infrastructure should still consider Bloom Energy as one of his preferred targets, and the stock could keep climbing over the next few years.

Bloom Energy’s stock has already surged 219% this year, including a 34% jump in September, mainly fueled by accelerated AI data‑center builds and rising on‑site fuel‑cell demand. Since Cramer first highlighted the company in February, the share price has almost doubled.

Bloom Energy’s core technology is a modular solid‑oxide fuel‑cell system that can be deployed near large‑load facilities such as data centers, providing primary or backup power without relying entirely on the public grid. The system converts fuel to electricity without traditional combustion, allowing modular expansion and serving as an alternative power source while AI data centers wait for grid connections.

One of the key constraints facing AI data centers today is electricity. Data‑center size is often measured by the gigawatts of continuous power required, and as AI compute demand rises, power supply becomes a decisive factor for expansion. Bloom Energy’s on‑site power solution promises to shorten the time needed to secure electricity, avoiding years‑long waits for new grid hookups.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) is one example. Bloom Energy said it completed power deployment to an Oracle data center in just 55 days, far quicker than the timeline typical for large‑scale grid projects. In April the two companies expanded their partnership, with Oracle’s AI and cloud infrastructure program set to purchase up to 2.8 GW of Bloom fuel‑cell systems, of which an initial 1.2 GW has already been contracted and is being rolled out.

Bloom Energy’s financials also reflect the rapid growth of AI data‑center demand. Q2 revenue reached roughly $1.07 billion, up 166% year‑over‑year and well ahead of expectations; adjusted EPS was $0.78, nearly double market forecasts. The company lifted its 2026 full‑year revenue outlook to $3.9‑$4.2 billion, with a midpoint of about $4.05 billion, implying revenue could double from the prior year.

For the full year 2025, Bloom Energy reported $2.02 billion in revenue, a 37.3% increase from $1.47 billion in 2024, noting that demand from the AI data‑center sector was a key driver of the record‑high sales.

Bloom Energy said that customers—including large hyperscale cloud providers, more than 12 neocloud operators, and AI labs—have either endorsed or completed validation of its technology, indicating that the on‑site power market is moving from early testing toward commercial deployment.

Bloom Energy has also been strengthening its AI‑power footprint. In September the company launched Power Connect technology, claiming to cut on‑site installation time by over 40%; it is also advancing an 800 V DC‑native power architecture to reduce losses and equipment needs associated with traditional AC conversion for high‑density AI compute workloads.

Bloom Energy also faces competition from other behind‑the‑meter power technologies, such as GE Vernova’s (GEV‑US) large gas turbines. Unlike Bloom’s modular fuel cells, GE Vernova relies on big gas turbines, but both firms are vying for the fast‑growing on‑site power demand of AI data centers.

As AI data‑center construction scales up, power supply is shifting from a peripheral issue to a core infrastructure concern for the AI industry. Bloom Energy’s sharply higher revenue this year, Oracle’s sizable order, and adoption by other AI players are drawing market attention to whether on‑site generation can become a major power source beyond the traditional grid.

However, Cramer cautioned investors not to chase Bloom Energy simply because he is bullish on AI power demand. Based on current market expectations, the stock trades at roughly 108 times this year’s estimated EPS and 59 times next year’s estimate, reflecting a very high growth premium already priced in.

Thus, while Cramer still views Bloom Energy as his top pick for AI power demand, he does not recommend buying immediately. He suggests waiting for a price pull‑back before evaluating a long‑term position. Bloom Energy is slated to release its Q3 results on October 27, when revenue, orders and AI‑data‑center‑related progress will be key gauges of continued growth.

items.title: 空中驚魂！以色列防長：杜拜航空是一起「恐怖襲擊未遂事件」
items.title_en: Airborne Horror! Israeli Defense Minister Calls Dubai Airlines Incident a ‘Foiled Terror Attack’
paras: 以色列國防部長卡茨30日（周三）發表聲明，稱當天發生的杜拜航空客機事件是一起「恐怖襲擊未遂事件」。
卡茨表示：「杜拜航空客機上發生的嚴重事件，是一起恐怖襲擊未遂事件。幾名以色列乘客的表現極為英勇，強行闖入駕駛艙，制服『恐怖分子』，並親手將飛機控制權交給了當時在場的另一名機組人員，這才挫敗了這起陰謀。」
卡茨表示，根據目前掌握的初步訊息，該名「恐怖分子」的意圖是「讓這架飛機連同機上所有乘客一起墜毀」。
以色列總理尼坦雅胡30日也證實，當天在一架載有以色列乘客的杜拜航空航班上，一名飛行員刺傷另一名飛行員後，企圖使飛機墜毀，後被乘客和機組人員制服。
尼坦雅胡說，襲擊嫌疑人已被逮捕，目前正在接受沙烏地阿拉伯當局訊問。
尼坦雅胡稱這起事件「極其嚴重」，以色列正與相關部門保持密切聯繫。尼坦雅胡已指示安全部門「做好應對其他潛在威脅的準備」。
paras_en: Israeli Defense Minister Yoav Gallant issued a statement on Wednesday, the 30th, saying that the incident involving a Dubai Airlines flight that day was a “foiled terrorist attack.”

Gallant said: “The serious incident on the Dubai Airlines aircraft was a foiled terrorist attack. Several Israeli passengers acted with extraordinary bravery, forcibly entering the cockpit, subduing the ‘terrorist,’ and personally handing control of the plane to another crew member who was on board, thereby thwarting the plot.”
Gallant added that, based on preliminary information currently available, the terrorist’s intent was “to cause the aircraft to crash together with all passengers on board.”

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also confirmed on the 30th that on a Dubai Airlines flight carrying Israeli passengers, a pilot stabbed another pilot in an attempt to bring the plane down, but was overpowered by passengers and crew.
Netanyahu said the suspect has been arrested and is now being questioned by Saudi Arabian authorities.

Netanyahu described the incident as “extremely serious,” noting that Israel is maintaining close contact with relevant agencies. He has instructed security forces to “prepare for any other potential threats.”

items.title: 柴油價格飆史高！川普承認「每天」討論出口禁令　Fed調查：高價恐需至少1年才回落
items.title_en: Diesel Prices Surge to Historic High! Trump Says He Discusses Export Ban "Every Day"; Fed Survey: Prices May Not Ease for At Least a Year
paras: 最新數據顯示，美國柴油價格攀漲至每加侖6.53美元，打破2022年創下的歷史新高紀錄，過去一年漲幅超過四成，嚴重衝擊物流、農業等實體經濟。面對11月期中選舉的民意壓力，美國總統川普周三(9月30日)說，「每天都在磋商」是否禁止柴油出口來壓價。
川普承認，切斷出口恐對汽油價格造成負面溢出，但能確實降低柴油成本。他將油價暴漲歸因於俄烏雙方頻繁襲擊彼此能源設施。
美國能源部長賴特指出，中東局勢惡化令柴油出口受阻，全球燃料供應鏈面臨廣泛中斷。除考慮全面出口禁令、推動煉油廠自願限產外，白宮也研擬擴大免稅柴油銷售，並敦促歐盟釋放應急儲備。
然而，行政干預能否奏效備受質疑。達拉斯聯準銀行最新調查顯示，近半受訪的油氣企業高管預期，柴油價格至少需要四個季度才能回落至2025年常態。業界形容「柴油是實體經濟的母乳」，通膨連環衝擊才剛開始，俄羅斯柴油短期內亦難重返市場。
Rystad Energy首席經濟學家Claudio Galimberti指出，歐洲與拉美買家高度依賴美國貨源彌補中東缺口，禁令將引爆海外油價，且墨西哥灣沿岸煉廠亦可能因出口受阻被迫降載，反而推高本土汽油與航空煤油成本。
與此同時，聯邦措施未定之際，地方已率先自救。德州州長Greg Abbott周一(9月28日)宣布全州進入「災難狀態」，放寬環保規定，允許農用染料柴油合法加注於公路貨車，並放寬軸重限制，以阻斷物價全面外溢。
paras_en: The latest data show U.S. diesel prices have climbed to $6.53 per gallon, breaking the record high set in 2022. Over the past year the price has risen more than 40%, severely hitting logistics, agriculture and other real‑economy sectors. Facing public‑opinion pressure ahead of the November midterm elections, President Donald Trump said on Wednesday (Sept. 30) that "we are negotiating every day" whether to ban diesel exports to push prices down.

Trump acknowledged that cutting off exports could have a negative spillover on gasoline prices, but it would definitely lower diesel costs. He blamed the sharp rise in fuel prices on the frequent attacks by both Russia and Ukraine on each other's energy facilities.

U.S. Energy Secretary Jennifer Granholm said the worsening situation in the Middle East is disrupting diesel exports and causing widespread interruptions in the global fuel supply chain. In addition to considering a full export ban and encouraging refineries to voluntarily cut production, the White House is also drafting plans to expand tax‑free diesel sales and urging the EU to release emergency reserves.

However, the effectiveness of administrative intervention is being questioned. A recent survey by the Dallas Fed shows that nearly half of the oil‑and‑gas executives surveyed expect diesel prices will need at least four quarters to fall back to a 2025‑type normal level. The industry describes diesel as "the mother’s milk of the real economy," warning that the inflationary shock is only just beginning and that Russian diesel is unlikely to return to the market in the short term.

Claudio Galimberti, chief economist at Rystad Energy, noted that European and Latin American buyers are heavily reliant on U.S. supplies to fill the gap left by the Middle East, and a ban would trigger overseas oil price spikes. He also warned that Gulf Coast refineries could be forced to cut runs because of export constraints, which would in turn push up domestic gasoline and jet‑fuel costs.

Meanwhile, before any federal measures are finalized, states are already taking action. Texas Governor Greg Abbott announced on Monday (Sept. 28) that the entire state is entering a "disaster emergency" status, loosening environmental regulations to allow agricultural dye‑diesel to be legally blended into highway trucks and relaxing axle‑weight limits in an effort to prevent price spillovers across the board.

items.title: 美光加碼2027會計年度資本支出無塵室擴建瞄準2028年後供給
items.title_en: Micron Increases FY2027 Capital Expenditure for Clean‑Room Expansion Aiming at Post‑2028 Supply
paras: 2026年10月01日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美光Micron Technology(MU-US)持續擴大記憶體產能布局，隨AI帶動DRAM、HBM與資料中心儲存需求升溫，公司已將2027會計年度資本支出提高至原先規畫以上，新增支出主要集中在無塵室建設，為2028年底及之後的產能需求預作準備。
美光目前正擴充全球多數生產基地，並在美國與日本建置新產能。其中，美國愛達荷州新廠預計2027年年中開始產出首批矽晶圓，不過管理層指出，新廠從開始生產到形成具規模的市場供給，仍需經過數季產能爬坡，因此短期供給增加速度有限。
在2027會計年度資本支出規畫中，美光表示，增加部分主要用於加速無塵室空間建設，大部分新增建設支出所對應的產能，要到2028年底及之後才會陸續到位。公司也強調，無塵室建成並不等於立即增加DRAM bit供給，後續仍需依市場需求決定設備進駐與實際產能建置速度。
管理層指出，目前記憶體產業最大的供給限制之一就是無塵室空間。AI需求快速增長的速度，明顯快於晶圓廠從規畫、興建、認證到設備進駐所需時間，即使新廠開始產出晶圓，真正轉化為有意義的市場供給仍需數季。
需求端也讓美光更有信心提前擴建。公司表示，AI帶來的記憶體需求已不再只來自GPU加速器，Agentic AI工作負載增加，也開始推升CPU伺服器對DDR、LPDDR及SSD的需求。管理層指出，伺服器出貨目前呈現高雙位數成長，DRAM正逐漸成為AI資料中心的重要供給限制之一。
長期供應協議也提高了美光對未來需求的能見度。公司目前已簽署26份長期供應協議，涵蓋DRAM與NAND，且2027會計年度超過75%的出貨量已獲客戶承諾，產能配置討論也開始延伸至2028年。部分長約甚至已涵蓋2030年之後，讓公司在擴建無塵室與安排未來產能時，能更貼近實際需求。
另一方面，HBM比重持續提高，也讓產能壓力進一步加大。美光指出，產品組合將由HBM3E轉向HBM4，並於2027年較後段進一步轉向HBM4E。新一代HBM的trade ratio持續提高，代表相同晶圓產能可轉換出的DRAM bit數下降，也會壓抑整體供給成長。
在這樣的供需結構下，美光一方面加速無塵室建設，另一方面仍會依照市場需求決定後續設備進駐與產能開出節奏，資本支出方向也從單純擴產，轉向提前為2028年後的AI記憶體需求預留空間。

paras_en: October 1, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Micron Technology (MU‑US) continues to expand its memory capacity footprint as AI drives hotter demand for DRAM, HBM and data‑center storage. The company has raised its FY2027 capital spending above the original plan, with the additional outlay focused mainly on clean‑room construction to prepare for capacity needs at the end of 2028 and beyond.

Micron is currently expanding most of its global fabs and adding new capacity in the United States and Japan. The new plant in Idaho is slated to ship its first silicon wafers in mid‑2027, but management notes that it will take several quarters of ramp‑up before the factory can deliver sizable market supply, so short‑term supply growth will be limited.

In its FY2027 capital‑expenditure plan, Micron says the increase will be used primarily to accelerate clean‑room space build‑out, with most of the new construction capacity coming online only after the end of 2028. The company also stresses that a completed clean‑room does not instantly translate into more DRAM bits; equipment installation and actual production scaling will still depend on market demand.

Management points out that clean‑room space is one of the biggest supply constraints in the memory industry today. The rapid rise in AI demand outpaces the time needed for a fab to go from planning and construction to certification and equipment installation, meaning that even when a new plant starts outputting wafers, it will take several quarters before that translates into meaningful market supply.

Demand gives Micron confidence to expand ahead of schedule. The firm notes that AI‑driven memory demand now comes not only from GPU accelerators but also from growing Agentic AI workloads, which are boosting CPU‑server demand for DDR, LPDDR and SSDs. Management says server shipments are currently growing at high double‑digit rates, and DRAM is becoming an increasingly critical supply bottleneck for AI data centers.

Long‑term supply agreements have also improved Micron’s visibility into future demand. The company has signed 26 long‑term contracts covering DRAM and NAND, and more than 75% of FY2027 shipments are already committed by customers, with capacity‑allocation discussions extending into 2028. Some contracts even cover periods beyond 2030, allowing Micron to align clean‑room expansion and future capacity planning more closely with actual demand.

On the other hand, the share of HBM in Micron’s portfolio keeps rising, adding further capacity pressure. Micron says its product mix will shift from HBM3E to HBM4, and later in FY2027 move toward HBM4E. The trade‑off ratio of the new‑generation HBM continues to increase, meaning that the same wafer capacity yields fewer DRAM bits, which will suppress overall supply growth.

Given this supply‑demand structure, Micron is accelerating clean‑room construction while still basing equipment installation and production rollout on market demand. Its capital‑spending focus is shifting from pure capacity expansion to pre‑positioning space for AI memory needs after 2028.

paras: 最新數據顯示，Meta的AI助理Muse上線約三週，下載量突破500萬次，成為美國 App Store免費榜榜首，並連12天居榜首位置。
根據市調機構 Sensor Tower高級洞察分析師Kara Lee預測，Muse下載量在9月30日(問世第22天)突破500萬次，達到這一規模所用時間明顯短於ChatGPT(56天)、Grok(103天)與Claude(492天)。
Sensor Tower數據顯示，美國市場僅有23款應用程式在上線22天內下載量超過500萬次。其中約85%為行動遊戲，如《Fortnite》《Pokémon GO》《Candy Crush》；非遊戲類僅3款：Disney+、HBO Max與Threads，同期下載量分別約2000萬、1800萬與 1400萬。
Muse被定義為「智能體AI助理」，可代表使用者執行多步驟任務，包括瀏覽網頁、發送電子郵件、線上購物、填寫表單以及預訂旅行行程。
Meta自9月16日起加大Muse廣告投放力度，當日下載量季增73%。過去兩週，Muse佔Meta自有廣告展示量的最高50%，臉書與WhatsApp展示份額相應下降。
paras_en: The latest data shows that Meta’s AI assistant Muse, launched about three weeks ago, has surpassed 5 million downloads, topping the free chart on the U.S. App Store and staying at number one for 12 consecutive days.

According to Kara Lee, senior insights analyst at market‑research firm Sensor Tower, Muse crossed the 5 million‑download mark on September 30 (its 22nd day on the market), achieving that scale in a markedly shorter time than ChatGPT (56 days), Grok (103 days) and Claude (492 days).

Sensor Tower data indicate that only 23 apps in the U.S. market have exceeded 5 million downloads within 22 days of launch. About 85 % of them are mobile games such as Fortnite, Pokémon GO and Candy Crush; the non‑gaming category includes just three apps—Disney+, HBO Max and Threads—with roughly 20 million, 18 million and 14 million downloads respectively during the same period.

Muse is defined as an “agent‑type AI assistant” that can act on behalf of users to perform multi‑step tasks, including browsing the web, sending emails, shopping online, filling out forms and booking travel itineraries.

Meta ramped up advertising for Muse starting September 16, driving a 73 % quarter‑over‑quarter increase in downloads on that day. Over the past two weeks, Muse accounted for up to 50 % of Meta’s own ad inventory, while the share of ads shown on Facebook and WhatsApp correspondingly declined.

items.title: 日銀政策轉向 未來升息可能加速
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Policy Shift May Accelerate Future Rate Hikes
paras: 《路透社》引述消息人士報導，日本銀行(BoJ)預期未來升息的速度將加快，頻率也會提高，以提前防範通膨超標的風險。這也讓本周公布的經濟數據更加重要，市場將藉此判斷央行下一步行動的時機。
如果周四公布的「短觀」調查顯示企業通膨預期進一步升溫，或周五公布的通膨數據顯示價格壓力擴大，都可能強化日銀在10月或12月再次升息的理由。
調查顯示，東京9月核心消費者通膨率可能已升至2.4%，較8月的1.8%大幅加速，顯示價格壓力正在擴大。
部分市場人士認為10月升息存在可能性。由於日本政府發出的干預匯市威脅未能提振日元，市場可能進一步要求央行透過更積極的貨幣緊縮政策支撐日元。
不過，由於日本銀行才剛升息，3名熟悉央行想法的消息人士表示，央行可能會為10月升息設定較高門檻。只有在外部衝擊提高通膨超標風險情況下，10月升息才可能成為選項。
其中一名消息人士表示，「雖然通膨風險確實存在，但目前沒有明確證據顯示價格增幅可能突然大幅飆升。」另一名消息人士也持相同看法。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)也已表示，若通膨存在急劇上升風險，或基礎通膨已經高於央行2%的目標，才可能連續升息。
但他同時強調，央行已準備「提前」採取行動，以避免日後被迫採取極端措施。這顯示日銀未來不會再在兩次政策會議之間耗費過長時間才提高借貸成本。
消息人士表示，「金融環境仍然寬鬆，因此央行需要視情況穩步升息。」
另一名消息人士透露，「隨著基礎通膨率逐漸接近2%，央行可能認為有必要稍微加快升息速度。」
與現任政策制定者仍保持密切聯繫的日銀前審議委員櫻井真(Makoto Sakurai)表示，他預期日本央行將把目前1.25%的政策利率，在明年6月左右提高至2%。
野村證券利率策略師Mari Iwashita表示，「關鍵在於央行將把2027會計年度的通膨預測上調多少……以及它會將通膨見頂的時間推遲多久。這將釋放非常重要的訊息，讓市場了解日本銀行升息的時機。」
paras_en: Reuters, citing sources, reported that the Bank of Japan (BoJ) expects to speed up the pace of future rate hikes and increase their frequency to pre‑empt the risk of inflation running above target. This makes this week’s economic data even more important, as markets will use it to gauge the timing of the central bank’s next move.

If Thursday’s short‑term business sentiment survey shows firms’ inflation expectations heating up further, or Friday’s inflation numbers reveal expanding price pressure, both could strengthen the case for another BoJ rate hike in October or December.
The survey indicates Tokyo’s core consumer inflation for September may have risen to 2.4%, up sharply from 1.8% in August, signalling growing price pressure.

Some market participants see a possibility of an October hike. Because the Japanese government’s threat to intervene in the FX market failed to lift the yen, markets may press the central bank for a more aggressive monetary‑tightening stance to support the currency.

However, since the BoJ has only just raised rates, three sources familiar with the bank’s thinking say it may set a high bar for an October hike, making it an option only if external shocks raise the risk of inflation overshooting its target.
One source said, “While inflation risk does exist, there is currently no clear evidence that price gains could suddenly surge dramatically.” Another source echoed the same view.
BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has also said that only if there is a risk of a sharp inflation rise or core inflation is already above the bank’s 2% target would consecutive hikes be considered.

He also stressed that the bank is prepared to act “in advance” to avoid being forced into extreme measures later, indicating the BoJ will no longer wait a long time between its two policy meetings to raise borrowing costs.
Sources said, “The financial environment remains accommodative, so the bank needs to raise rates steadily as conditions warrant.”
Another source added, “As core inflation gradually approaches 2%, the bank may deem it necessary to speed up the pace of hikes slightly.”

Former BoJ policy‑review board member Makoto Sakurai, who still maintains close contact with current policymakers, expects the bank to lift the current 1.25% policy rate to around 2% by roughly June next year.

Nomura Securities rate strategist Mari Iwashita said, “The key is how much the bank will raise its FY2027 inflation forecast… and how long it will push back the timing of inflation peaking. That will release a very important signal for the market about when the BoJ will hike rates.”

但數據公布後，美元回吐部分漲幅，隨後又有所回升。同時，美國公債殖利率一開始全面下滑。通常與聯準會利率預期同步變動的2年期公債殖利率，下跌0.4個基點至4.885%。

他指出，「這次重新定價正拉低美國公債殖利率，並縮小美元的殖利率優勢，為最新一波美元賣壓提供了明確的基本面催化因素。」

paras_en: The dollar was flat against major currencies on Wednesday (Sept. 30) after U.S. inflation came in lower than expected, easing market bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, held steady at 101.47. The index rose in September, ending a two‑month streak of declines.
Higher oil prices, which push inflation, had initially led the market to expect the Fed to keep tightening, and the dollar rose alongside U.S. Treasury yields.

After the data release, the dollar gave back some of its gains before edging higher again. At the same time, Treasury yields initially fell across the board. The two‑year yield, which usually moves in step with Fed rate expectations, dropped 0.4 basis points to 4.885%.
The euro was unchanged at $1.133050. The euro‑dollar pair still shows a monthly decline after two consecutive months of gains.

BNY foreign‑exchange and macro strategist John Velis said, "We can't tell whether it was the revised PCE data itself or other factors that caused the numbers to come in lower than expected. The result initially pushed bonds higher, yields lower, and weakened the dollar."

He added, "We had previously seen some strong GDP numbers: the long end of the yield curve has in part recovered, while the short end is still falling, making the curve steeper. So the two‑year yield fell, reflecting reduced market expectations for an October hike, and the dollar weakened accordingly."

U.S. Commerce Department data showed that the Fed‑preferred inflation gauge, the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, rose 0.3% last month, versus the 0.4% increase economists surveyed by Reuters had forecast.
According to CME's FedWatch tool, traders now assign a 37% probability to a Fed rate hike in October, down from 70% a week earlier.

LMAX Group market strategist Joel Kruger said, "Today's weaker PCE report, combined with New York Fed President John Williams' opposition to rushing another hike, has sharply lowered market expectations for consecutive Fed rate increases."
He noted, "This repricing is pulling U.S. Treasury yields lower and narrowing the dollar's yield advantage, providing a clear fundamental catalyst for the latest wave of dollar selling pressure."

Oil prices jumped sharply in September as stalled U.S.–Iran peace talks stalled the war‑ending process. Brent crude futures for November delivery, which expire on Wednesday, rose 0.92% to $103.53 a barrel.
The dollar was flat at 157.34 yen.
The dollar rose 0.26% to 0.83575 Swiss francs, marking a second consecutive month of gains.
The pound climbed 0.26% to $1.3265, but it is down against the dollar for the month, ending two months of upward momentum.
The Australian dollar fell 0.57% to $0.6948.
The New Zealand dollar slipped 0.09% to $0.5635.

items.title: 〈台幣〉季底拋匯支持微升收31.852元 月、季線同步翻黑
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Ends Month Slightly Higher at 31.852, Month and Quarter Lines Turn Negative
paras: 台北股匯今(30)日同步收月線、季線，呈現股匯雙漲，新台幣兌美元匯率終場收在 31.852 元、升值 2.4 分，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 28.17 億美元。9 月單月累計貶值1.86角、貶幅0.58%，月線翻黑，第三季累計貶值 1.5 分或 0.05%，季線同步翻黑。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.85 元，外資呈現雙向進出，不過，出口商把握季底最後一個交易日拋匯，使得匯價最高來到 31.805 元，尾盤升幅收斂，收在 31.852 元，升值 2.4 分。
台股今天展開反彈，一度勁揚逾 700 點，但台積電漲幅回吐，加權指數再度失守4萬8千點大關，留下上影線，但仍守住五日線，收在47,940.13點，上漲308.17點，外資買超 308.56 億美元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.08%，韓元升值 0.44%，日元升值 0.31%，星幣升值 0.18%，新台幣升值 0.08%，人民幣則小貶 0.01%。
投資人關注美國周三公布的8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)，這項數據受到聯準會密切關注，接下來周五即將公布9月非農就業報告。
paras_en: The Taipei stock and foreign exchange markets closed today (30th) simultaneously on the monthly and quarterly lines, showing a dual rise in stocks and currency. The New Taiwan dollar ended the session at 31.852 per US dollar, appreciating 0.024, with total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign exchange markets reaching $2.817 billion. For September alone the currency depreciated 0.186 NTD (0.58%), turning the monthly line negative, while for the third quarter it fell 0.015 NTD (0.05%), also turning the quarterly line negative.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 31.85 per US dollar. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but exporters seized the last trading day of the quarter to sell foreign exchange, pushing the rate up to a high of 31.805. The gain narrowed toward the close, ending at 31.852, a rise of 0.024.

Taiwan stocks rebounded today, surging more than 700 points at one point, but TSMC’s gains were given back, and the weighted index slipped below the 48,000‑point mark again, leaving a long upper shadow. Nevertheless, it held above the five‑day moving average, closing at 47,940.13, up 308.17 points, with foreign investors net buying $30.856 billion.

Looking at major currencies today, according to central bank statistics, the US dollar index fell 0.08%, the Korean won rose 0.44%, the Japanese yen rose 0.31%, the Singapore dollar rose 0.18%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.08%, and the Chinese yuan slipped 0.01%.

Investors are watching the US personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index for August, to be released on Wednesday, a data point closely monitored by the Federal Reserve, with the September non‑farm payroll report scheduled for release on Friday.

items.title: 英國第2季GDP優於預期 但經濟學家憂下半年表現
items.title_en: UK Q2 GDP Beats Expectations, but Economists Fear H2 Performance
paras: 英國國家統計局(ONS)周三(30日)公布的最新修訂數據顯示，英國第二季GDP季增 0.5%，優於先前預估與市場預期的 0.4%。
帶動成長的主力來自服務業產出季增 0.6%(其中專業、科學及技術活動成長 2.3%)，以及淨貿易大幅改善，出口量成長 2.8%。此外，實質家庭可支配所得回升 1.0%，企業投資季增 1.8%，展現上半年經濟的強勁韌性。
這些數據證實，儘管中東戰事重燃通膨壓力，但消費者在夏季仍持續消費，推動英國經濟在上半年表現遠超預期。
數據公布後，英鎊匯率擴大漲幅，一度上漲0.2%，至1.3259美元。
服務業活動的顯著擴張與出口反彈，是第2季 GDP 能超越預期的核心力道。對此數據，ONS 經濟統計主管 Liz McKeown 指出：「最新一季更強勁的服務業成長，意味著經濟規模比先前估計的稍微擴大。」
然而展望下半年，經濟學者警告，受能源價格上限調升、生活成本再度飆升以及地緣政治引發的通膨壓力影響，第三與第四季經濟成長率恐放緩至 0.2%。
對此，英國財政大臣 John Healey 承諾將在 10 月 28 日公布的預算案中，給予家庭與企業「喘息空間」。但在金融市場預期央行可能持續升息及債券市場波動下，政策調控仍面臨嚴峻挑戰。
paras_en: The UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) released revised data on Wednesday (the 30th) showing that the country's GDP grew by 0.5% quarter‑on‑quarter in the second quarter, beating the previous forecast and market expectation of 0.4%.

Growth was driven mainly by a 0.6% rise in services output (with professional, scientific and technical activities up 2.3%) and a sharp improvement in net trade, with exports up 2.8%. In addition, real disposable household income rebounded 1.0% and corporate investment rose 1.8% quarter‑on‑quarter, demonstrating strong resilience in the economy during the first half of the year.

These figures confirm that, despite renewed Middle‑East conflict adding inflationary pressure, consumers kept spending throughout the summer, pushing the UK economy’s first‑half performance well beyond expectations.
Following the data release, the pound widened its gains, briefly rising 0.2% to $1.3259.

The pronounced expansion in services activity and the export rebound were the core forces behind the second‑quarter GDP outperformance. Commenting on the data, ONS economic statistics chief Liz McKeown said, “The stronger services growth this quarter means the economy is a little larger than previously estimated.”

However, looking ahead to the second half of the year, economists warn that higher energy price caps, a resurgence in living‑cost pressures and geopolitically‑driven inflation could slow growth in the third and fourth quarters to as low as 0.2%.

In response, UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey pledged to give households and businesses “breathing space” in the budget to be presented on October 28, but with financial markets expecting the central bank may keep raising rates and bond market volatility, policy adjustments still face a tough challenge.

items.title: 美日聯合示警與升息預期發酵 日元升破157關卡 成G10最強貨幣
items.title_en: US-Japan Joint Warning and Rate Hike Expectations Fuel Yen Surge Past 157, Becomes Strongest G10 Currency
paras: 日元周三(30日)在東京匯市大幅走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破157大關，盤中一度大升0.6%至156.38日元，躍居G10中表現最強。 這波強勁反彈主要受美日當局強烈的口頭干預訊號、日央追加升息預期，以及季末企業資金回流等三大因素共同帶動。
政治與官方政策層面上，美日兩國針對日元過度貶值展現出前所未有的協調姿態。 日本財務官三村淳日前指出，美日雙方對於日元估值過低的立場共享著「極為明確」的訊息。日本首相高市早苗表示，美國總統川普在會談中直接對日元持續疲軟表達了憂慮。
日本財相片山皋月公開強調，日方將繼續與美國財長貝森特保持緊密溝通，市場解讀此舉顯示華府對日元走強的態度已從口頭支持轉向更實質的政策協調。
另一方面，貨幣政策的緊縮預期進一步為日元提供支撐。 日本央行於9月政策會議將基準利率由1%調升至1.25%後，面對全球高通膨壓力，市場押注日央最快可能在10月再次升息。
自美日兩國於7月啟動15年來首次協調干預、日本單月砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元以來，日元自接近164的低點持續反彈，本季度累計升幅已達3.5%至3.6%左右。
市場交易結構方面，三井住友信託銀行分析指出，9月底恰逢第三季季末，國內出口商大量資金本國回歸等特殊實需買盤湧現，推升了日元走勢。華僑銀行外匯策略師Moh Siong Sim表示，川普的表態強化了美日深化合作的預期，加上干預風險使市場對做空日元保持謹慎，160關卡已被市場視為官方行動的重要防線。
paras_en: The yen surged sharply on Wednesday (30th) in Tokyo’s foreign exchange market, with the USD/JPY rate falling below the 157 threshold and briefly jumping 0.6% intraday to 156.38 yen, making it the strongest performer among the G10 currencies. This strong rebound was driven by three main factors: strong verbal intervention signals from US and Japanese authorities, the Bank of Japan’s added rate‑hike expectations, and the end‑of‑quarter corporate cash repatriation.

On the political and policy front, the United States and Japan have shown an unprecedented coordinated stance against the yen’s excessive depreciation. Japanese Finance Minister Shun Miyazawa recently noted that both sides share a “very clear” message regarding the yen’s undervaluation. Prime Minister Kishida said that President Trump directly expressed concern about the yen’s continued weakness during their talks.

Japanese Finance Minister Shun Miyazawa emphasized that Japan will continue close communication with US Treasury Secretary Yellen, and markets interpret this as Washington shifting from verbal support to more substantive policy coordination on a stronger yen.

On the monetary‑policy side, tightening expectations further underpin the yen. After the Bank of Japan raised its benchmark rate from 1% to 1.25% at its September policy meeting, markets, facing global high‑inflation pressure, are betting that the BOJ could hike rates again as early as October.

Since the US and Japan launched their first coordinated intervention in 15 years in July, with Japan dumping a record 15.4 trillion yen in a single month, the yen has rebounded from near a 164 low, delivering a cumulative rise of about 3.5%‑3.6% this quarter.

Regarding market trading structure, Mitsui Sumitomo Trust Bank noted that the end of September coincided with the third‑quarter quarter‑end, prompting a surge of genuine buying demand from domestic exporters repatriating large amounts of capital, which lifted the yen. OCBC’s foreign‑exchange strategist Moh Siong Sim said Trump’s remarks reinforced expectations of deeper US‑Japan cooperation, and the intervention risk has made traders cautious about shorting the yen, with the 160 level now seen as a key defensive barrier for official action.

items.title: 利差重新主導匯市！美元兌歐元9月飆升近2.5%創14個月之最　後市待PCE與非農數據裁決
items.title_en: Yield Gap Reclaims Dominance in FX Market! Dollar/Euro Soars Nearly 2.5% in September, Highest in 14 Months; Future Hinges on PCE and Non‑Farm Data
paras: 受美歐利差擴大與歐洲能源、財政隱憂的雙重驅動，美元兌歐元匯率9月累計上漲接近2.5%，創14個月來單月最大升幅，歐元兌美元周一(28日)一度貶值至1.1312美元，為2025年5月以來最低，目前仍在1.1334附近交易。
美元兌歐元這輪升勢的主線是利差，而非單一避險交易。美元強勢的背後是美國成長與利率預期相對更強，美國經濟保持韌性，市場重新提高對聯準會(Fed升息路徑的預期，高利率推升美元資產的收益率吸引力。只要美國短端和長端利率明顯高於歐洲，全球資金就更有動力持有美元債券和現金資產。
美元強勢也擴散至其他貨幣，瑞士法郎兌美元一度跌至16個半月低點，澳元則跌破0.7美元，為8月初來首見。
歐洲正同時承受能源與財政雙重壓力，基準歐洲天然氣價格9月一度上漲至2022年以來最高，能源重新成為經濟與通膨定價的重要變數；法國債市壓力也在擴大，法德公債殖利率利差升破115個基點，為2012年以來最大，進一步削弱歐元資產的相對吸引力，這正是美元上漲並非單純避險交易的關鍵證據，因歐元自身的結構性壓力，構成美元強勢的另一半支撐力量。
與此同時，Fed內部並未一致主張快速連續升息，這給美元設了上限。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯表示，9月升息後「沒有必要急於」再次行動。威廉斯表態後，兩年期美債殖利率周二(29日)下降約3.5個基點，而芝商所FedWatch最新數據顯示，市場對10月再升息機率從約71%降至50%。如果美國數據轉弱、市場持續降低10月升息機率，美歐利差進一步擴大的空間將隨之收窄。
但美元未必立即反轉。歐元本身的壓力依舊存在，當前匯率更像是美國利率優勢與歐洲基本面共同作用的結果。
Spectra Markets總裁Brent Donnelly指出，美元若要從目前水準進一步上行，需要強勁的美國數據持續提供動力。
聯準會偏好的核心PCE通膨指標將於周三(30日)出爐，週五(10月2日)還有美國非農就業報告。若就業數據持續強勁，市場可能重新提高升息預期。若PCE與非農雙雙偏強，美元可能重新測試本輪高點。
paras_en: Driven by widening US‑Euro yield differentials and Europe’s energy and fiscal worries, the dollar‑euro pair rose almost 2.5% in September, the biggest monthly gain in 14 months. The euro fell to $1.1312 on Monday the 28th – its lowest since May 2025 – and is now trading around $1.1334.

The main driver of this dollar‑euro rally is the yield gap, not a pure safe‑haven move. The dollar’s strength reflects relatively stronger US growth and rate expectations, with the US economy staying resilient. Markets have lifted expectations for the Fed’s tightening path, and higher US short‑ and long‑term rates make dollar‑denominated assets more attractive. As long as US rates stay clearly above European rates, global capital is motivated to hold dollar bonds and cash.

The dollar’s vigor also spilled over to other currencies: the Swiss franc slipped to a 16‑and‑a‑half‑month low against the dollar, and the Australian dollar fell below $0.70, a first since early August.

Europe is simultaneously grappling with dual energy and fiscal pressures. Benchmark European gas prices spiked in September to their highest level since 2022, making energy a key factor for the economy and inflation pricing again. French bond market stress is widening, with the Franco‑German sovereign yield spread breaking 115 basis points – the widest since 2012 – further eroding the relative appeal of euro assets. This structural strain on the euro, not just safe‑haven flows, underpins the dollar’s rise.

Meanwhile, the Fed is not united on rapid, consecutive hikes, putting a ceiling on the dollar. New York Fed President Williams said after the September hike there is “no need to rush” into another move. Following his comments, the two‑year Treasury yield fell about 3.5 basis points on Tuesday the 29th, and CME’s FedWatch showed the odds of a October hike slipping from roughly 71% to 50%. If US data weaken and the market keeps trimming October‑hike odds, the room for further US‑Euro yield spread expansion will narrow.
But the dollar may not reverse immediately. Euro‑specific pressures remain, and the current rate reflects a combination of US rate advantage and European fundamentals.
Spectra Markets President Brent Donnelly said that for the dollar to move higher from current levels, it will need continued strong US data to provide momentum.

The Fed‑preferred core PCE inflation reading is due on Wednesday the 30th, with the US non‑farm payroll report scheduled for Friday October 2nd. If employment data stay robust, markets may raise rate‑hike expectations again. A strong PCE and payroll report could push the dollar back to test its recent highs.

items.title: 期中選舉倒數5周！川普宣布啟動32天全美巡迴拉票行程   力保共和黨國會兩院多數
items.title_en: Midterm Election Countdown: 5 Weeks Left! Trump Announces 32-Day Nationwide Campaign Tour to Boost Republican Majorities in Both Chambers
paras: 美國總統川普週二(29日)在白宮外證實，11月3日期中選舉前將展開為期32天全美競選巡迴，親赴多州為共和黨候選人助陣，首站包括本週的德州、俄亥俄州。川普此舉把總統本人與執政表現直接綁上國會兩院控制權保衛戰。
川普啟動全美「拉票」的背景是油價與海外伊朗雙線承壓。《路透社》報導指出，汽油價格持續墊高家庭成本，選民對生活支出不滿；同時白宮今年大量資源投入對伊朗政策與外交安全事務，中東局勢膠著成選戰辯論焦點。
近來，川普公開淡化油價與伊朗帶來的政治壓力，稱共和黨候選人「都希望我去助選」，並否認有同黨人士刻意保持距離。
這波巡迴啟動時間晚於顧問原先規劃。白宮官員透露，因伊朗衝突、聯合國大會及相關安全事務佔據多數時間，催票排程被壓後，直至選前倒數五週才全速推進。
川普受訪時未公布全部行程，僅確認多州接力，目標是用其支持者動員能力鞏固紅州與搖擺州出票人數。
不過，共和黨候選人態度並不完全一致。部分競選團隊歡迎總統站台，盼川普基本盤拉升募款與造勢，部分選區則更強調地方就業、稅務、治安與個人政績，避免被全國化爭議綁架。
根據路透民調，民主黨在若干眾院關鍵選區勢頭不弱，並在參院多個席次形成拉鋸。若高油價與伊朗政策持續發酵，可能影響獨立選民取向。
後續看點在於川普巡迴節奏與候選人策略如何對接：一方面以「總統牌」凝聚保守動員，另一方面避免將地方選情全盤變成對伊朗行動與能源價格的公投。若共和黨保住兩院，川普剩餘任期推動稅務、能源、移民與國防案將會更順，但失去眾院或參院多數，行政部門將面對更強立法牽制與聽證調查壓力。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump confirmed on Tuesday (the 29th) outside the White House that he will launch a 32‑day nationwide campaign tour before the November 3 midterm elections, personally visiting multiple states to support Republican candidates, with the first stops this week in Texas and Ohio. Trump’s move directly ties his own presidency to the fight to defend control of both chambers of Congress.

The backdrop for Trump’s nationwide "vote‑getting" push is pressure from both rising oil prices and the Iran issue abroad. Reuters reported that gasoline prices are continuously raising household costs, fueling voter dissatisfaction with living expenses; at the same time the White House has poured substantial resources this year into Iran policy and diplomatic security matters, making the stalemate in the Middle East a focal point of election debate.

Recently, Trump has publicly downplayed the political pressure from oil prices and Iran, saying Republican candidates "all want me to campaign for them" and denying that any party members are deliberately keeping their distance.

The tour’s start was later than advisors originally planned. White House officials said that the Iran conflict, the United Nations General Assembly and related security issues occupied most of the time, pushing back the voter‑mobilization schedule until the final five weeks before the election, when it was accelerated at full speed.

Trump did not disclose the full itinerary in the interview, only confirming a relay of stops across multiple states, aiming to use his supporter‑mobilization ability to cement vote totals in red states and swing states.

However, Republican candidates are not uniformly aligned. Some campaign teams welcome the president’s appearances, hoping Trump will boost fundraising and rally the base, while other districts emphasize local jobs, taxes, public safety and personal achievements to avoid being hijacked by national controversies.

According to a Reuters poll, Democrats are showing solid momentum in several key House districts and are engaged in tight races for multiple Senate seats. If high oil prices and Iran policy continue to evolve, they could sway independent voters.

The next focus will be how the rhythm of Trump’s tour aligns with candidate strategies: on one hand using the "president brand" to rally conservative voters, on the other avoiding turning every local contest into a referendum on Iran actions and energy prices. If Republicans retain both chambers, Trump’s remaining term could see smoother progress on tax, energy, immigration and defense legislation; losing the House or Senate majority would subject the administration to stronger legislative checks and heightened hearing investigations.
